ability.sba.ice_guard.desc: Block in front of you, just like a shield. When the purple shield meter takes enough damage, your guard drops. If freezing is unlocked in the vampire fate, also can make opponents colder.
ability.sba.aura_push.desc: Fires vampiric aura in front of you, pushing mobs it hits slightly. Also pushes you backwards if you are in the air when you shoot it.
ability.sba.invis_vamp.desc: If you stand still, lets you blend into your surroundings and appear completely invisible.
ability.sba.deflection.desc: Enter a temporary state of deflecting most incoming projectiles.
ability.sba.ripper_eyes.desc: Charges up a continuous beam that does massive damage and bleed, traveling through even blocks. Can be interrupted. If you press it again, you can fire it off early as a weaker projectile.
instruction.sba.passive_manhattan: Enter Control Mode or Activate Wind Vision
ability.sba.punch.desc: Throws a punch directly in front of you. Hold it down for a 3 hit-combo!
ability.sba.guard.desc: Block in front of you, just like a shield. When the purple shield meter takes enough damage, your guard drops.
ability.sba.barrage.desc: Trap your enemy in a flurry of blows, sending them flying at the end.
ability.sba.kick_barrage.desc: A faster charging barrage that does not disable enemy attacks.
ability.sba.punch_fate.desc: Throws a punch directly in front of you. Hold it down for nonstop attacks!
ability.sba.toggle_brawl.desc: Activate to change your attack and interact buttons to special abilities! Can be toggled on and off. While in brawl mode, you break blocks quickly.
ability.sba.cold_punch.desc: Must activate brawling to use! Throws a punch directly in front of you. Hold it down for nonstop attacks! Hits make opponents colder!
ability.sba.cold_guard.desc: While the stand is active, you cover yourself in ice that transforms into your stand's vision. Provides a passive stand guard 180 degrees in front of you, like using a shield. This guard protects from a number of things including fall damage, fire, and sunlight. When the guard runs out, the armor is temporarily cracked. Grants you resistances to heat and cold.
ability.sba.freeze_cancel.desc: Negate your ice, gradually removing it. This ability deactivates your skates.
ability.sba.ice_twister.desc: Creates a miniature blizzard where you are looking. It freezes the ground into sticky ice that slows and traps opponents. Those standing in the twister get colder.
ability.sba.gently_weeps.desc: Uses massive amounts of stand power to freeze the air surrounding you, reaching -215 degrees Celsius. Rapidly freezes anything in its radius. Unless covered in blood, deflects many types of incoming projectiles.
ability.sba.gently_weeps_attach.desc: If you are inside of gently weeps, attaches it to you losing its cold property but in exchange letting you deflect projectiles on the go with a longer lifespan. As your stand has ice walls and gently weeps has massive cold build, this ability is very situational.
ability.sba.ice_wall.desc: Makes a wall of ice appear from the ground. In front of you, it can block mobs and projectiles. If aimed beneath you, you can rise up along with it. Damaging the blocks with enough force breaks them. You can use this to your advantage to carve into the wall and jump on top of it.
ability.sba.ice_wall_behind.desc: Makes a wall of ice appear from the ground behind you. This replaces dash while skating, and is good from blocking those chasing you using with your trail. With punching mode, the ice wall blocks can be launched as damaging projectiles.
ability.sba.skate_activate.desc: Attaches skates to your armor, granting you speed and gradual acceleration. Skating uphill lowers your acceleration, while skating downhill increases it. You leave a trail of ice that others swiftly slide across to catch up to you, and you can easily use your other abilities to lace it with traps. Freezes water in a manner similar to frost walker.
ability.sba.block_freeze.desc: Using your ability to freeze any material, you turn certain blocks into cold variants. Cold blocks can be mined rapidly, so you can easily break obsidian and the like. They drop as unique building materials, and can easily be reverted with a flint and steel.
ability.sba.suit_power.desc: The suit provides a slight passive increase in attack power.
ability.sba.full_accel.desc: If you build up maximum acceleration with your skates active, the final icon's border will become yellow. If you jump while this is active, you do a trick jump and twirl around, going slightly further. If you instead attack an opponent in this state, it is a critical hit and deals significant knockback.
ability.sba.cold_blast.desc: Must activate brawling to use! Release interact after the meter reaches the end to fire a projectile of stand energy that freezes the blocks it passes by into stand ice. Mobs it passes through become colder. Makes sticky ice where it lands. If sneaking upon releasing or on crouch toggle mode, it makes ice spikes where it lands which also can inflict bleed.
ability.sba.sweep_kick.desc: Throws a kick in a short range directly in front of you. The knockback is quite high. If used in the air, it instead makes you slam into the ground, briefly dazing mobs it hits.
ability.sba.spike_stomp.desc: After falling for enough time, activating this skill makes you slam into the ground, briefly dazing mobs it hits and inflicting bleed.
ability.sba.spike_push.desc: If facing a  block, pushes you in the direction opposite the block.
ability.sba.spike_pull.desc: If facing a  block, pulls you towards the block.
ability.sba.hair_grab.desc: Pulls a mob in towards you.
ability.sba.hair_spikes.desc: After a while, extends hair spikes around you damaging mobs in a radius.
ability.sba.blood_clutch.desc: After a brief delay, dashes forwards. Damages a mob on contact. If the mob that is hit can bleed, drinks their blood, potentially zombifying them on death.
ability.sba.ice_clutch.desc: After a brief delay, dashes forwards. Damages a mob on contact. If the mob can be frozen, begins the process off freezing them, potentially slowing and weakening them. When fully frozen, mobs shatter on hit. Must be unlocked in vampire fate.
ability.sba.dodge_air.desc: A quick burst of speed, useful for dodging. If you time it with a jump, it travels further, but takes longer to recharge. Can be used in the air, making you turn invisible briefly in the process.
ability.sba.combo.desc: Abilities build up combo points displayed above the exp bar when used consecutively. Combo points make your attacks deal more damage.
ability.sba.forward_barrage.desc: While barraging, your stand starts to float forward slowly.
ability.sba.disc_imprint.desc: Use a stand disc with no stand on it to remove your current stand and store its data on the disc.
ability.sba.disc_swap.desc: Use a different stand disc with a stand on it to swap stands. No materials are lost in the process.
ability.sba.impale.desc: Winds up a deadly attack that may inflict level 3 bleed. You have to get within close range to land it.
ability.sba.impale_blitz.desc: Winds up a deadly attack that may inflict level 3 bleed. You have to get within close range to land it. Press the attack key to use the move early, this alternative version is a fast uppercut, it is called Star Blitz.
ability.sba.block_grab.desc: Grabs the block you are facing. Attack to throw, Guard to pocket. The harder the block, the more powerful it is. Useful for building in survival mode. May require the correct tool being in your inventory to grab.
ability.sba.item_grab.desc: Grabs the item you are holding in your inventory to throw. Many of them have unique attributes.
ability.sba.mob_grab.desc: Grabs the entity you are facing, if it is close enough and able to be grabbed. Throw them, transport them, or gently set them down. If you are crouching, you do an attack on them.
ability.sba.mob_grab_sp.desc: Grabs the entity you are facing, if it is close enough and able to be grabbed. Throw them, transport them, or gently set them down. If you are crouching, you do an attack on them. Can also remove flesh buds.
ability.sba.phase_grab.desc: Your stand floats forward, phasing through some blocks with slits in them like iron bars or slabs. Grabs items on the ground from afar, or interacts with levers and doors.
ability.sba.dodge.desc: A quick burst of speed, useful for dodging. If you time it with a jump, it travels further, but takes longer to recharge.
ability.sba.stand_leap.desc: Use the power of your stand to jump onto the block you are facing, if it is within range. Can travel greater vertically than horizontally.
ability.sba.stand_leap_rebound.desc: Rebound off of walls in the middle of a leap, propels you in the direction you are looking.
ability.sba.fall_brace.desc: Use the power of your stand to brace the impact of a fall. Long falls still deal damage, but it is reduced.
ability.sba.vault.desc: Press while looking at a ledge, your stand will extend its arm to grab on and launch you up.
ability.sba.vault_kc.desc: Press while looking at a ledge, your stand will extend its arm to grab on and launch you up. If aimed at a standard wall, can do a shorter launch a couple of times, or chain a shorter launch into a full vault.
ability.sba.time_stop.desc: Charge up to stop time itself, freezing everything! You can resume time early to recharge faster, and actions taken in stopped time influence recharge time as well.
ability.sba.time_stop_impulse.desc: Instantly starts up Time Stop without a need to double press a key. Exists strictly as a panic button to avoid incoming attacks.
ability.sba.scope.desc: Zooms in with Star Platinum's eyes up to 3 levels, with night vision. Useful for mining and seeing far away. Catches certain projectiles.
ability.sba.star_finger.desc: Stretch Star Platinum's finger to hit up to 8 blocks away! Pierces through mobs and shields, and can inflict bleed. If you press attack, you can release a lesser version of it early.
ability.sba.inhale.desc: Star Platinum sucks in air rapidly, pulling entities towards you. It is really good at picking items and experience off of the ground!
ability.sba.final_punch.desc: Hold and release to throw a super powerful punch! The longer you hold it down, the stronger it is.
ability.sba.final_kick.desc: Hold and release to throw a super powerful kick! The longer you hold it down, the stronger it is.
ability.sba.assault.desc: The World floats forwards in front of you, attacking whatever it touches and inflicting bleed! Pressing grab while this moves is active allows it to pick up blocks instead. For the attack, it becomes more powerful the longer it charges, so spinning it around like a flail lets it reach maximum power.
ability.sba.air_tanks.desc: The tanks on The World's back provide you with extra air, so you can swim underwater for much longer.
ability.sba.fog_sword.desc: Your weapon attacks charge up faster, and you mine at a faster speed while Justice is active.
ability.sba.cast_fog.desc: Casts fog over a large area, exposing illusionary blocks and animating corpses for you to control. Players without Justice see less.
ability.sba.fog_morph_2.desc: Appear to others as a villager. Has decent trades at fixed rates, and are respected by golems.
ability.sba.fog_morph_3.desc: Appear to others as a zombie. You will be ignored by other zombies, but feared by villagers and attacked by golems.
ability.sba.fog_morph_4.desc: Appear to others as a skeleton. You will be ignored by other skeletons, but hated by wolves, dogs, and golems.
ability.sba.fog_chain.desc: Pulls mobs that are bleeding in fog towards the block you are looking at. Many mobs can bleed if you attack them with scissors, charged glaives, knives, or barbed wires.
ability.sba.fog_blocks.desc: Create limitless fog blocks, on demand. When placed, they can only be seen while fog is cast, and can be walked through (as they are just illusions).
ability.sba.corpse_army.desc: Acquire corpses with Executioner's Axe or kill them with justice summoned, and craft a body bag to store them in. You can control these corpses if they are in your fog range. Corpses must be inactive or full health to be picked up by a body bag. Zombies, Skeletons, Creepers, Spiders, Villagers/Illagers, and Phantoms can become corpses. Interact with spider corpses you control to ride them.
ability.sba.zombie_corpse.desc: Zombie corpses can be acquired from zombies and husks. When activated, they are the most basic and well balanced army unit. If you crouch and interact with them, you can give them your held item, or trade their held item back. They can place blocks they are given if commanded to directly with interact in control mode, and can use mining tools to mine with the same control. Note that held items trade off corpse armor piercing damage. Healed with rotten flesh while inactive.
ability.sba.villager_corpse.desc: Villager corpses can be acquired from villagers, witches, and other illagers you may find in a raid. They are similar to zombie corpses, albeit slightly faster and weaker, and cannot be given items. Their strength lies in their hidden resistance to projectiles, making them great at charging at those who are wielding ranged weapons. Healed with emeralds while inactive.
ability.sba.creeper_corpse.desc: Creeper corpses can be acquired from creepers. They act as creepers do, so they may be a bit dangerous to use. However, in control mode, pressing interact on them detonates them. If you select and move a fallen creeper around first, this can be utilized to deliberately blow up holes in walls, or simply help you mine. Healed with gunpowder while inactive.
ability.sba.skeleton_corpse.desc: Skeleton corpses can be acquired from skeletons and strays. They are an overwhelming long range option. While not very powerful, they are good at knocking back and interrupting foes with their synchronized group shots. Just be careful, as their arrows can harm you as well, and the other corpses. Thus, they pair well with fallen spiders which are shorter and harder to hit with arrows. Healed with bones while inactive.
ability.sba.spider_corpse.desc: Spider corpses can be acquired from regular, full sized spiders. They are very fast and hard to hit. If you interact with them, you can mount them, and use them to ride up walls. They are perfect for gaining distance while eating or charging glaives. Healed with spider eyes while inactive.
ability.sba.phantom_corpse.desc: Phantom corpses can be acquired from phantoms. They can slowly move up and down to attack enemies who are at a different elevation than you, but their health is very low and they are vulnerable to harpoons. This is because their main use is as a mount. Exclusively at night time in the overworld, they can fly you around. This is because the night sky gives them power. Holding space makes you rise higher, and holding the dash ability key makes you sink lower. Healed with membranes while inactive.
ability.sba.king_chop.desc: Hold and release to do a more powerful attack. At less than half charge, it is a weak hit. At half and above, it becomes a chop attack that inflicts bleed. When fully charged, it loses the bleed but gains even more power, launching opponents quite far.
ability.sba.epitaph.desc: Shows you a forecast of the future. You see entities at their future positions, blinding yourself to the present. Skipping time then moves everything to these positions, sealing their fate.
ability.sba.time_skip.desc: Skips about 5 seconds of time. Everyone then becomes disoriented. In skipped time, all that's left is the result, with no hint of how it was reached. Since you remove yourself from fate, you alone can skip through dangers like lava and fall damage. Potion effect time is skipped as well, as are furnace cooking times. Players eating will finish eating, and others using items will stop doing so.
ability.sba.time_skip_2.desc: A variation of skip that appears while epitaph is up. Moves entities to their forecasted locations, sealing their fates. Great for strategic positioning in fights.
ability.sba.time_skip_3.desc: A variation of skip that appears while epitaph is up. While you're blocking, you see your own fated position that is generated based on your movement input when epitaph is pressed. Skipping time puts you in that position. It's good for knowing exactly where you are traveling, and standing still and pressing epitaph can also let you create an anchor point of sorts. Does not work on walls.
ability.sba.blood_splash.desc: You cause yourself to bleed and launch the blood at great force. This skill damages opponents and temporarily blinds players. If used during time erase, it will be stored on the target. When time erase is resumed, the target will not take damage, but be confused/blinded for longer. Builds up bleed on yourself you're already bleeding, but time skip counteracts this. If you have bleed II or higher, your bleed time will not increase.
ability.sba.time_erase.desc: Blows away roughly a dozen seconds of time. During that erased time, things progress normally, but you are removed from fate. Thus, you can walk through mobs and take no damage from anything. Healing is paused as well, and you cannot use any items or interact with the world meaningfully. You can hover by holding jump. Mobs are distracted by your fated self. Attacking cancels it (with the sole exception of blood splash). The more time you use, the longer it takes to recharge.
ability.sba.time_erase_clone.desc: During erased time, your fated actions play out as they would have. Mobs punch at what appears to be the air, and get attacked by your fated actions. Your inputs before pressing time erase determine its actions: If you walk backwards, your fated self turns and walks away. If you sprint, your fated self will too. If you are off the ground, it will jump erratically. If you run from your current attack target, it will as well. If you stand still or sneak, it will copy those motions. Arms Mode makes it peaceful.
ability.sba.hologram.desc: Epitaph is like a projector. Instead of using it on your hands, hair, etc, you use it to show a glimpse of the future to those around you. This hologram appears to every player as themselves. Mobs will attack it like a decoy if it is closer to them than you. As a result, you can manipulate their positions with time skip.
ability.sba.fog_clones.desc: Create fake mirages of yourself. If you are attacked, perhaps it was one of the mirages that was attacked, not you...
ability.sba.tactics.desc: Highlight corpses, and change settings of highlighted corpses.
ability.sba.fog_pilot.desc: Switch to the perspective of Justice, and fly around the foggy sky. On top of surveying the area, you can command corpses from above to move around (use key) and attack (attack key) your targets, after highlighting the target you are mousing over (attack key). Interact with creeper corpses you control to blow them up. If you give a zombie corpse an item by sneaking and interacting, they can use tools to mine and place blocks they are holding with the attack key in this mode. Press again to return to your body.
ability.sba.red_lash.desc: Uses Red Bind's flame rope offensively to lash opponents, has increased reach! Hold it down for a 3 hit-combo!
ability.sba.flame_kick.desc: Hold and release to throw a super powerful kick! The longer you hold it down, the stronger it is. Once it charges fully, it releases automatically. Releasing it early throws a punch instead.
ability.sba.fireball_barrage.desc: Rapidly shoots a sequence of fireballs that knock enemies back with an explosive force, can start stand fires where they land.
ability.sba.flamethrower.desc: A stream of fire that can damage multiple targets at once, setting them on stand fire.
ability.sba.furnace.desc: Adds a button in the menus of furnace type blocks (furnace, blast furnace, and smoker). Pressing this button lights up the furnace with the stand's flames.
ability.sba.red_bind.desc: Winds up a lasso ability, you have to get within close range to land it. It allows you to walk mobs around as if pulling them with a lead. Attacking causes the target to rise up and be held in place for a few seconds or until hit, while blocking or pressing the button again cancels it.
ability.sba.flame_creation.desc: Places stand fire down where you are looking. Stand Fire spreads like normal fire, but does armor piercing damage like other stand abilities, and only stand users can see it. It is capable of burning upside down as well, and produces no smoke.
ability.sba.life_detector.desc: Creates a life detector made of flames, which can be pushed along. Within a 15 meter/block radius, highlights all mobs nearby.
ability.sba.crossfire.desc: Begins charging a powerful ankh made of flames, which gains more power, knockback, and flame spread as it grows. Press again to shoot the ankh out.
ability.sba.crossfire_block.desc: If holding a block and charging a crossfire hurricane, this ability becomes available. Conceals the hurricane in a floating block, and if an enemy close by hits it, it explodes on them alone.
ability.sba.crossfire_ground.desc: If charging a crossfire hurricane, this ability becomes available. Buries the hurricane in the ground, it will seek out and explode your last target.
ability.sba.crossfire_special.desc: Creates a ring of stand fire around you, as well as four medium-sized crossfire hurricane ankhs which circle around you. Press again repeatedly to shoot out those ankhs.
ability.sba.flame_extinguish.desc: Snap away all stand fire you created at once.
ability.sba.projectile_burn.desc: Burns away incoming projectiles, and ignites incoming gasoline projectiles. Destroys flesh buds.
ability.sba.crossfire_firestorm.desc: Creates a large ankh which scatters tiny flames everywhere, increasing the power of your standard crossfire hurricanes and allowing you to use them in rain. The massive toll on stand energy, however, increases their cooldowns. This does not enhance hurricane special.
ability.sba.fire_slam.desc: Launches Magician's Red forward, turning it into a ball of fire. It collides with extreme force and lots of flames, but in doing so your stand is sealed for a while. Only use as a last resort.
ability.sba.self_burn.desc: If you are cold because of certain abilities, you will gain the ability to light yourself on stand fire to counteract the cold. Normal stand fire damage applies.
ability.sba.spike_attack_mode.desc: Lets you press or hold the attack key to launch a spike attack, pulling mobs in with a damaging attack that inflicts bleed. If interact is held, it pushes them away instead. This mode runs on a meter that must be full to use the ability, and recharges when not using it. Goes through walls.
ability.sba.heel_plant.desc: Extends your heel spikes into the ground, allowing you to resist most forms of knockback and walk on walls. Gives you a step height increase in both directions. Disables some abilities while active, deactivates when airborne or pressed again. It is canceled after enough enemy hits.
ability.sba.wall_walk_move.desc: Latches onto walls, allowing you to walk on them. Trigger by facing a wall while having your heels planted, or by being in the air.
ability.sba.firm_swing.desc: Makes all attacks critical attacks while your heel is planted, due to the increased force from a sturdy stance.
ability.sba.fall_disperse.desc: Halves incoming fall damage, spreading the impact across your heels.
ability.sba.corner_cut.desc: Enable this to skip the process of direction adjustment when running off a wall to cut corners. Also inhibits accidental jumps and lowers speed. Think of it as training wheels.
ability.sba.steal_memories.desc: After a mob breaks your currently set rule, allows you to turn a memory of theirs into a chess piece. Interacting reads the memory type. This ability generally makes mobs forget what they are doing, losing aggro on you. but it can also do other things like make villagers forget reputation, flip golem types, remove illager learned hatred, and make witches forget good and bad potions.
ability.sba.save_location.desc: Saves your current location into a chess piece. Using the piece creates particles that fly in the direction of the saved location. You can give these pieces to other people to help them find places, or just use them yourself to keep track of locations.
ability.sba.steal_memories_2.desc: If possible, this variation of memory steal takes experience away from mobs, and using the chess piece will give it to you. This is useful for taking experience from mobs without killing them. On villagers, instead saves their workplaces. On players, saves their bed locations. Using the pieces leads you to the locations.
ability.sba.step_shadow.desc: If you step in the shadow of someone you stole the memory of (touching you without low light levels), any memories taken are returned to them from your inventory.
ability.sba.forbid_rule.desc: Forbid people from stepping on the block you activate this skill on. If you step on the block, the rule is undone by a lack of fairness.
ability.sba.piece_attack.desc: If you attack while holding stolen memories, you can hurt the people they belong to remotely, and even inflict bleed. However, the pieces lose this ability if their targets are not around.
ability.sba.leave_rule.desc: Bind yourself to someone. If they leave your side and go far enough, they break this rule. Animals and villagers follow you automatically when tethered so you can use this to move them around. If you take certain movement actions, the rule is undone by a lack of fairness.
ability.sba.hurt_rule.desc: Forbid people from hurting you while you are in the cowering stance this ability triggers. Stealing memories after using this mysteriously fixes resulting injuries, leg or otherwise? If you attack an opponent, the rule is undone by a lack of fairness.
ability.sba.exp_bishop.desc: Creates a special chess piece that stores experience. Attacking stores up to 10 levels of exp (1 while holding shift), and using returns up to 10 levels to you (1 while holding shift).
ability.sba.rule_change.desc: Changes the rule you currently are using. Essentially, cycles between the forbid/hurt/leave rules.
ability.sba.sleep.desc: Your stand becomes a special bed that doesn't save your spawn point. Only works in worlds where sleeping is possible. You can also use this ability to make your stand a temporary platform.
ability.sba.visage_creation.desc: Allows you to use experience levels to create any visage you like, or to create lucky lipstick. NPCs with this stand may charge emeralds instead.
ability.sba.face_removal.desc: Launches an attack that inflicts bleed and faceless, an effect that softens enemies up for attacks and makes some mobs self-conscious. Subsequent hits of this attack increase the effect level.
ability.sba.visages.desc: Faces of iconic characters that you can create. Equip in the power inventory (this menu). The mask slot changes appearance, and the voice slot may add voice lines depending on the visage.
ability.sba.lucky_lipstick.desc: Apply every 3 minutes, before the effect runs out, and you will be glowing with beauty, capturing love. Villagers will trade better with you. Apply until you sleep or drink milk, or something bad may happen...
ability.sba.encasement_strike.desc: Hold and release to throw a powerful kick! If you fully charge it, it becomes less damaging punch, but encases the target in a bubble and makes them float away.
ability.sba.bubble_barrage.desc: Charges a bunch of punches which do not directly damage opponents. Rather, they bury explosive bubbles into the ground which start moving towards recent attack targets, then pop out of the ground and fire at the targets.
ability.sba.bubble_selection.desc: Opens a selection screen to choose something to "take away" things. Changes all plunder bubbles you create after selecting from the screen. The screen gives detailed descriptions of every plunder type.
ability.sba.go_beyond.desc: Ends explosive spin mode to launch an imaginary bubble. It does not exist in this world, passing through mobs, blocks, time stop, shields, logic itself, and other things. It seeks out the target you are hovering over when you launch it, and cannot be stopped. It does massive damage and knockback, inflicting high bleed.
ability.sba.bubble_spread.desc: Spreads many plunder bubbles around you, taking away things on contact. If the spread exists, this ability instead pops the entire spread.
ability.sba.bubble_spread_redirect.desc: Redirects bubbles created from bubble spread towards the block or entity you are facing. Only applies to bubbles that have not yet taken things away.
ability.sba.plunder_bubble.desc: Creates a bubble that takes things away when it makes contact. Use bubble selection to choose what these things are. The bubble follows your cursor as it moves forward.
ability.sba.bubble_pop.desc: Pops all of your active bubbles. Applies to almost all bubble types, including shooting mode bubbles which deal knockback around them when popped.
ability.sba.bubble_redirect.desc: Redirects plunder bubbles that have already taken something away towards the block or entity you are facing.
ability.sba.item_launching_bubble.desc: Creates an explosive bubble that launches your held item. It drops the item and hurts on contact, but if you use the bubble pop skill manually, it launches the item towards whatever you are facing. Can be used for building.
ability.sba.bubble_scaffold.desc: Builds temporary blocks of bubbles towards the direction you are facing, moving your cursor changes its building direction as it builds. You can move more slowly over these blocks. But you can also climb them like a ladder, drop through them, and protect mobs that land on them from a lot of fall damage.
ability.sba.encasement_bubble.desc: Creates an encasement bubble. Players can right click encasement bubbles to become surrounded by them, increasing jump height as jump is held, removing fall damage, and providing immunity to certain things like Powder Snow or Air Pressure. Attacking with a sharp object or taking damage pops it. Can also touch non-player mobs to go over them as protection and can be sheared off.
ability.sba.shooting_mode.desc: Toggles shooting mode. You stop holding items, and instead you fire off explosive bubbles when you press the attack button. Once the red bar on the bottom reaches the top, you cannot shoot, and need to wait for it to decrease. Fill the blue bar by shooting to enter explosive spin mode where you temporarily can shoot infinitely and potentially fire off go beyond.
ability.sba.water_shield.desc: Uses up water in a held water bottle to shield you from many projectile types for a short while. If they make contact, they instead turn into explosive item bubbles which you can pop to launch back at foes. Also puts out fires on you.
ability.sba.plug_wound.desc: Restores a tiny amount of health and cures up to 1 level of bleed. Amidst this process, you are slowed.
ability.sba.danger_yap.desc: Hey Ya will watch out for mobs that target you, and bring them to your attention.
ability.sba.mining_yap.desc: Hey Ya will look for ores around you, and bring them to your attention.
ability.sba.yap_yap.desc: Hey Ya will cheer you on and make your day better!
ability.sba.chrono_vision.desc: Lets you see phantom clocks at the rewindable positions of entities. Their stream of time embers shows the direction the entity was facing.
ability.sba.rewind_time.desc: Rewinds time by 6 seconds, to the same positions that are visible if you choose to use Chrono Vision. It rewinds things such as positions, healths, and status of entities. It does not rewind everything about an entity, nor does it rewind blocks/items/cooldowns. But it can save your life and disorient your foes. Killing mobs/interfering with blocks distorts time, causing a longer cooldown.
ability.sba.watch_switch.desc: A physical manifestation of your mental switch to rewind time. Equips and cycles through watches. As it is physical, those without stands can see it.
ability.sba.clock.desc: Displays a clock when active, so you can know the time of day in applicable dimensions.
ability.sba.throw_bottle.desc: Throws a held water bottle directly from your inventory, it travels far and is good for activating the stand.
ability.sba.summon_survivor.desc: Place your stand down where you are looking, up to a certain range. When it is doused with water, it activates, and zaps the nerves of nearby mobs. This causes them to fight each other to the death. You can be zapped as well, locking you into a fight. When zapped, melee power increases, and you resist damage that is not melee.
ability.sba.desummon_survivor.desc: Every instance of your stand that you place down starts to disappear. This does not remove existing anger, so be careful what violence you choose to incite.
ability.sba.target_zap.desc: Lets you select which mobs fight each other! Enter selection mode, use your attack key to select an activated survivor, then one target, and then another. They will then fight! Press the ability key again to cancel or redo selection. While this mode is active, your survivors will not automatically zap mobs together.
ability.sba.stand_vision.desc: Allows you to see stands and ghost phenomenon passively. This ability applies even when using other powers, so long as you have a stand.
ability.sba.stand_passives.desc: Some stand abilities like passive fall damage reduction or furnace activation apply even when using other powers, so long as you have the corresponding stands equipped.
ability.sba.stand_summon.desc: Allows you to summon and use your stand, and all of its abilities seen in the stand disc tab.
ability.sba.invisivision.desc: Turn on and off the ability to see see-through versions of blocks and entities that you turn invisible with your power. Turning it off is useful to get the perspective of someone without the stand, and to see through invisible blocks better.
ability.sba.invisiburst.desc: Release your emotions in a burst of invisibility, making you and all nearby entities invisible. It decreases your range of being seen, and wears off overtime, or when you do certain actions. Activating this ability briefly lets mobs see you. If the stand griefing gamerule is off, temporarily makes blocks that are not ores around you invisible too, which can assist in mining. Invisible blocks are without properties, and cannot be blown up.
ability.sba.controlled_burst.desc: A variation of Invisiburst with decreased range and no block invisibility. Signifies greater control of the user's emotions. Useful if you don't want to accidentally make your opponents invisible.
ability.sba.place_invis.desc: Place blocks, passing your invisibility duration down to them. Only works while you are invisible. To activate this skill, you must be holding a block and invisible.
ability.sba.ratt_scope.desc: Hold Ratt and scope in, allowing you to shoot directly. Holding sneak zooms in further. Interacting builds charge, and attacking releases it as a flurry of darts. After 10 blocks of travel, the darts automatically bounce to the nearest target.
ability.sba.ratt_fire.desc: Shoots a volley of three darts, inflicting melt and disabling guard on the final hit.
ability.sba.ratt_mode_change.desc: Changes your manual firing mode between Single Fire and Burst Fire. Single Fire shoots one, stronger dart with greater knockback, damage, and melt duration.
ability.sba.ratt_place.desc: Place Ratt down, allowing Ratt to fire alongside you. Sneaking highlights ratt and displays the distance to you. Ratt is immune to being hit for a brief period upon being placed.
ability.sba.ratt_place_burst.desc: Shoot a burst of 3 darts from Ratt's position to your cursor.
ability.sba.ratt_auto.desc: Target an entity in sight and Ratt will automatically fire at it.
ability.sba.ratt_flesh.desc: Drops from melting creatures. Slows mobs and is difficult to break. However, having Ratt equipped bypasses these restrictions, allowing you to move freely and pick them up instantly by right-clicking.
ability.sba.ratt_bucket.desc: Buckets can pick up ratt flesh in a wide area, allowing you to quickly pick and place them down.
ability.sba.ratt_leap.desc: Launches Ratt in a direction, allowing you to quickly reposition them.
ability.sba.ratt_mining.desc: Locks Ratt to the block you are facing, causing it to automatically shoot in that direction indefinitely. In this mode, if griefing is enabled, it can melt blocks, making it gradually drill a hole.
ability.sba.ctr_passives: We Believed We'd C. T. R.
ability.sba.ctr_passives.desc: Catch The Rainbow's abilities can only be used in the rain. While in the rain, you gain a speed boost and you become immune to fall damage.
ability.sba.ctr_rain_platform.desc: Stabilize the raindrops below your feet, allowing you to hover and run mid-air. [WIP]
ability.sba.ctr_life_clutch.desc: When receiving fatal damage, survive at half a heart and become invincible for two seconds. This ability takes a long time to recharge.
ability.sba.ctr_barrier.desc: Stabilize the raindrops around you, creating a sharp barrier that blocks projectiles and inflicts bleed. [WIP]
ability.sba.ctr_rain_mend.desc: Use raindrops to plug your wounds, restoring one heart and healing a level of bleed.
ability.sba.ctr_choke.desc: Detach your offhand and throw it forwards, chokes and slowly suffocates mobs hit. Your thrown arm can also pick up items from the ground. [WIP]
ability.sba.ctr_rain_dash.desc: A quick burst of speed, useful for dodging. While in the rain, it has a greatly reduced cooldown and can also be used mid-air.
ability.sba.ctr_drop_down.desc: Quickly drop down towards the ground. Can hit mobs, dealing good damage and making you bounce upwards.
ability.sba.ctr_full_dodge.desc: Disassemble your body. For a second, you dodge any incoming danger but you can't attack. [WIP]
ability.sba.anubis_attack.desc: Swing Anubis, dealing a sweeping attack. Goes through walls. When empowered, do a sweeping cut.
ability.sba.anubis_sneak_attack.desc: Charge up a dashing uppercut. When empowered, swipe in front of you, launching any blocks in your path
ability.sba.anubis_pogo.desc: Dive forwards and swing your sword, breaking shield. Does not require your attacks to be off cooldown. When empowered, launch even further and inflict bleed.
ability.sba.anubis_quickdraw.desc: Wind up your sword, then lunge forwards with incredible speed, cutting everything in your path. When empowered, do a quick barrage in front of you.
ability.sba.anubis_shieldbreak.desc: Do a brief windup, then swipe in front of you. Does moderate knockback and breaks shields for a long time. When empowered, spin around, knocking back and bleeding enemies.
ability.sba.anubis_alluring_light.desc: Hypnotize all mobs near you, causing them to follow you for a while.
ability.sba.anubis_raging_light.desc: Force all mobs nearby to target you.
ability.sba.anubis_backflip.desc: Backflip to safety and can be done midair, restoring your pogo. Hold sneak to fastfall.
ability.sba.anubis_record.desc: Choose a slot and record a series of inputs. Pressing your hotbar keys lets you change the icon. The duration scales with your level
ability.sba.anubis_replay.desc: Choose a slot and replay the memories stored within.
ability.sba.anubis_mouse.desc: Using this while hovering on a memory slot will allow it to remember your mouse motions.
ability.sba.anubis_exp.desc: Due to Anubis' learning ability, you passively gain up to 50% more exp, even while Anubis is inactive
ability.sba.anubis_speed.desc: Anubis grants incredible athletic ability, allowing you to move much faster and jump higher than before
ability.sba.anubis_sword_throw.desc: In exchange for sealing your stand, throw Anubis forwards, phasing through walls and wounding whatever it hits
ability.sba.anubis_empower.desc: Enter a stance that does a different, stronger attack depending on what button you press.
ability.sba.anubis_dodge.desc: A quick burst of speed, useful for dodging. If you time it with a jump, it travels further, but takes longer to recharge. When empowered, dodge past projectiles.
ability.sba.tusk_saw.desc: Swing your spinning nails, with a 2 hit combo. The nails are also capable of mining akin to axes and swords if you hold sneak.
ability.sba.tusk_blast.desc: Charge up to 10 nails, firing them in a spray. Full charge breaks guard.
ability.sba.tusk_spinthrow.desc: Launch a small projectile, such as flint or nuggets, hurtling them forwards.
ability.sba.tusk_shockwave.desc: Wind up a shockwave that rips through targets and breaks shields..
ability.sba.tusk_leap_1.desc: Graze your nails against the ground and after a moment, using the recoil to launch upwards.
ability.sba.tusk_leap_2.desc: Graze your nails against the ground, using the recoil to launch upwards.
ability.sba.tusk_leap_3.desc: Graze your nails against the ground, using the recoil to launch upwards. Press left click to launch nails from your toes.
ability.sba.tusk_drill.desc: Your nails now spin along an axis, allowing you to drill opponents with left click, and mine akin to pickaxes and shovels if you hold sneak.
ability.sba.tusk_target.desc: Direct your holes to attack specific mobs, [NYI, work on blocks?].
ability.sba.tusk_brush.desc: Use your drill nails to brush away at blocks.
ability.sba.tusk_ball_bridge.desc: Shoot an iron ingot and throw it forwards, unraveling it into a bridge or ladder-like rope. Hitting an entity tangles them.
ability.sba.tusk_focus.desc: Enter a hole, allowing you to shoot, move, and place blocks through it. Holding sneak lets you enter into your last fired hole
ability.sba.tusk_flatten.desc: Plunge into a hole, evading aggression and attacks.
ability.sba.tusk_grab.desc: Grab a mob and pull them through the hole, dealing heavy damage and unbalancing them. Cannot kill.
ability.sba.tusk_warp.desc: Move between holes after a windup, scaling with distance. Getting hit resets the time.
ability.sba.tusk_advance.desc: Tusk advances slowly. If it contacts an entity it charges an unblockable, uninterruptable barrage that inflicts Infinite Spin.
ability.sba.tusk_inverse.desc: Undo either your or a target's infinite spin, consuming your infinite spin charge in the process.
ability.sba.tusk_wall_breaker.desc: Shoot a nail that splits apart a wall, floor, or ceiling temporarily, allowing you to pass through freely.
ability.sba.tusk_charge.desc: Holding attack builds up the nail's strength, increasing the potency and duration of the holes. Holes pursue targets autonomously, inflicting a debuff which reduces their projectile accuracy.
ability.sba.tusk_charge_4.desc: Shoot a slow-firing nail that contains Tusk Act 4. On contact, Act 4 pops out to punch the target.
ability.sba.tusk_change_modes.desc: Swap between Melee and Ranged modes. Your right click is unaffected by the stand.
ability.sba.kn_smell_track.desc: Send out King Nothing to track the scent of the Block, Mob, or Player you currently have memorized.
ability.sba.kn_track_item.desc: King Nothing smells your held item and detects other Players or Chests which have that item.
ability.sba.kn_phase_item.desc: King Nothing will take your held item and use it to do different things. It can do things like place blocks, mine blocks, and even attack enemies!
ability.sba.kn_drop_item.desc: King Nothing will drop its currently held item where it is. Certain items like ender pearls and potions will do special things when dropped. Holding sneak will disable any special interactions, in case you don't want to do them.
ability.sba.kn_form_predict.desc: Memorize the scent of the original form of your currently held item.
ability.sba.kn_sniff.desc: Memorize the scent of the Block, Mob, or Player you are currently looking at.
ability.sba.blood_drink.desc: Consume blood through your hands so long as you remain facing your target, damaging them to restore your blood. If a mob has drinkable blood, the indicator will appear in the middle of the screen. If a mob is not agitated, you can score a critical blood suck. Villagers and Illagers will zombify upon being killed by this skill, and can be controlled. You can also absorb held plants for direct health.
ability.sba.blood_drink_simple.desc: Consume blood so long as you remain facing your target, damaging them to restore your blood. If a mob has drinkable blood, the indicator will appear in the middle of the screen. If a mob is not agitated, you can score a critical blood suck.
ability.sba.vampire_passive.desc: You evaporate in sunlight. You run on blood instead of hunger, and eating raw foods and monster drops provide blood with no penalties. You cannot die of starvation. Drowning only lowers your speed. Iron Golems detest you, while zombies are neutral with your presence. You take decreased fall damage.
ability.sba.mass_heal.desc: Funnels all of your blood into health regeneration, temporarily slowing you down. This ability triggers automatically when you die, if possible, providing a last stand.
ability.sba.wall_walk_vamp.desc: Latches onto walls, allowing you to walk slowly on them. Trigger by facing a wall in the air. Press again while wall walking and facing another wall to switch walls, or to step onto ceilings.
ability.sba.vampire_vision.desc: While enabled, allows for passive dark vision as well as a longer jump height while jump is held. (The jump height skill indicates how high this currently is)
ability.sba.zombie_passive.desc: You are harmed by smite. Some potion effects are nullified or reversed: you are classified as undead.
ability.sba.zombie_passive_2.desc: Your strength, defense, and held jump height are increased. You can see in the dark.
ability.sba.zombie_disguise.desc: Activate or de-activate freely. If your disguise is on, you are treated normally by golems and targeted by zombies. However, many of your zombie abilities and properties are sealed to make the disguise convincing.
ability.sba.zombie_worm.desc: Killing enemies with blood suck gives you a zombiefish which you can then summon. Maxes at 5. Zombiefish target your attack target.
ability.sba.zombie_projectiles.desc: If you are holding knives, arrows, or knife bundles, you can sift them through your body and fire them off shotgun style.
ability.sba.zombie_enter.desc: Lets you mount just about any animal. Passively, so long as you are not disguised, you hide inside of animals you are mounted to and this lets you drive them past the sun so long as you do not attack/use items.
ability.sba.vamp_jump_boost.desc: Grants 3 meter jump height and 5 meters while sneaking. Hold down for the longer jumps, and tap for shorter ones. With the powers moveset active, grants %1$s meter jump height and %2$s meters while sneaking.
ability.sba.vamp_strength.desc: Exceed the limits of humanity. +%1$s percent damage for direct melee attacks against mobs, +%2$s against players.
ability.sba.vamp_dexterity.desc: Practice moving your limbs at unnatural speeds. +%1$s percent mining speed, +%2$s percent attack speed.
ability.sba.vamp_resilience.desc: Practice shifting your body to cushion against certain attack types. +%1$s percent reduced incoming melee damage, +%2$s percent reduced incoming damage from some projectiles.
ability.sba.hypnotism.desc: Turn on and off hypnotic pulses that cause nearby mobs to follow you. Hypnotized villagers do not alert for reputation changes when their blood is drained.
ability.sba.super_hearing.desc: Concentrate entirely on the sound of heartbeats, allowing you to find mobs through walls and estimate their health. %1$s block radius.
ability.sba.blood_speed.desc: A massive cheetah-like speed boost at the cost of half of your blood, allowing you to step up blocks as well. Speed increases by %1$s percent.
ability.sba.blood_speed.locked.desc: Use consumed life force to amplify your speed...
ability.sba.grafting.desc: When killed by vampires, certain mobs drop parts which can be applied to your zombie minions through interaction with this upgrade. Changes their properties and/or grants new abilities.
ability.sba.grafting.locked.desc: Give your undead army an upgrade...
ability.sba.flesh_bud.desc: Plants a flesh bud in the mob, making them attack your enemies (and never you). Some mobs need to be at low health first.
ability.sba.flesh_bud.locked.desc: Assert further control over most mobs...
ability.sba.sacrificial_dagger.desc: Instead of hurting you, sacrificial daggers now shoot out your blood as healing projectiles. It also puts living mobs under a special effect, and if they die under this effect they become vampire versions and fully heal. As a vampire, they are stronger but die in the sun- and drink blood of nearby mobs to heal.
ability.sba.sacrificial_dagger.locked.de: Your blood has special healing properties. Maybe you can use that to your advantage...
ability.sba.unleash_the_cold.desc: Grants vaporization freeze to the powers moveset. Power it up to make it better.
ability.sba.unleash_the_cold.locked.desc: You notice your body temperature is below that of a human. Can you make use of this unique property? (powers moveset)
ability.sba.eye_manipulation.desc: Grants space ripper stingy eyes to the powers moveset. Power it up to make it better.
ability.sba.eye_manipulation.locked.desc: As you practice your newfound body manipulation skills, you wonder what would happen if you manipulate your eye fluids. (powers moveset)
ability.sba.gd_punch_left.desc: Separate your main hand from your body, throwing it out to attack or mine with the item in your main hand! Use again to control its movement.
ability.sba.gd_spin_left.desc: Causes your seperated main arm to spin in place, repeatedly attacking nearby entities. If the arm hits a targets feet, it knocks anything it hits upwards.
ability.sba.gd_punch_right.desc: Separate your Off hand from your body, throwing it out to attack or mine with the item in your off hand! Use again to control its movement.
ability.sba.gd_spin_right.desc: Causes your seperated Off hand  to spin in place, repeatedly attacking nearby entities. If the arm hits a targets feet, knocks anything it hits upwards.
ability.sba.gd_mold_leap.desc: Separates your torso and legs, and launches you in the direction you are looking, allowing for great horizontal moblity whilst letting you avoid fall damage. Leaves you crawling while your legs float back to you, damaging mobs they come into contact with and letting you walk again. Your legs automatically return after a time. Block to stop your legs from moving.
ability.sba.gd_mold_field.desc: Entities in range of your mold will take heavy damage as they get lower. Entities killed in this way have a chance to drop their head. In addition, any entities that die in the mold will increase its range and duration. Eating food will cause the mold to disappear.
ability.sba.gd_stitch.desc: Stitches you up, recovering a tiny bit of health, and reducing bleed by 1 level.
ability.sba.gd_pardon.desc: Select entities as allies, making them unaffected by your mold.
ability.sba.gd_mold_spread.desc: Create a cloud of mold spores, affecting all entities caught in them with mold. These spores drift downwards, increasing in range until they hit the floor.
ability.sba.gd_mold_off.desc: Instantly remove any of your clouds of spores.
ability.sba.kq_guard_bubble.desc: Upgraded form of Guard. Blocks in front of you just like a shield. Stray Cat's Bubble increases blocking capacity.
ability.sba.kq_fast_kick.desc: Charge a fast kick, fully charge does a heavy punch with high knockback.
ability.sba.kq_config.desc: Opens a menu to customize the behavior of Primary Bomb skills. Adjusts whether bombs can break blocks, if they destroy items, if they detonate manually or on entity contact, and their explosion size. Increasing explosion size increases the cooldown of Primary Bomb skills. Ores broken by bombs will only drop items if the necessary tool is in your inventory.
ability.sba.kq_bomb_mob.desc: Plants a bomb on the mob you are facing after a long, interruptable windup. When detonated, deals very high damage to mobs and one-shots players.
ability.sba.kq_bomb_block.desc: Plants a bomb on the block you are facing. Only the user can see where the bomb is planted.
ability.sba.kq_bomb_item.desc: Plants a bomb on the item you are holding and drops it on the floor. Item bombs can't be picked up until defused. Some items have unique interactions, being held and manually thrown by Killer Queen. Arrows transfer their bomb status to mobs on hit and the throw strength can be charged with left-click. Ender Pearls can be detonated mid-flight to teleport to that location in exchange for taking explosion damage. Knives and Rifle Ammunition can be thrown without needing to charge, but Rifle Ammunition deals reduced hit and explosion damage.
ability.sba.kq_sha_summon.desc: Summons Sheer Heart Attack, an automatic tracking bomb that prioritizes hot entities/blocks, exploding on contact. Naturally hot mobs, like blazes, are prioritized, as are burning entities. Targets with low enough heat, including Vampire/Zombie players, and active White Album users are ignored. Sheer Heart Attack can drive up walls to pursue targets.
ability.sba.kq_sha_throw.desc: Throws Sheer Heart Attack in the direction you are facing, allowing it to directly strike a target or cover distance more quickly.
ability.sba.sha_mining.desc: Right-clicking Sheer Heart Attack with a torch causes it to continuiously travel in a straight path, exploding on contact with blocks. The explosions do not destroy ores.
ability.sba.obtain_btd.desc: Use a Stand Arrow on yourself to unlock Bites the Dust skills.
ability.sba.kq_btd_mode.desc: Sends Killer Queen floating forward, attaching itself to a standless host on contact. Killer Queen will protect its host from incoming damage like a Stand Guard. While in a host, Killer Queen cannot protect the user or use the majority of its skills. A time counter replaces the EXP bar, allowing the user to track the loop timeline.
ability.sba.kq_btd_combat.desc: Reveals Killer Queen to all targets near the host, turning back time to the start of Bites the Dust and marking them to explode at the timestamp of the reveal. This skill can be used up to 3 times within a single instance of Bites the Dust. The skill is automatically used when the host dies or is protected by Killer Queen.
ability.sba.kq_btd_day.desc: After a long, interruptable windup, turns back time to the start of the Minecraft day and marks all targets near the host to explode at the timestamp of the reset.
ability.sba.kq_btd_defuse.desc: Removes Killer Queen from its host, returning it to the user. All targets that were marked to explode will be unmarked.
ability.sba.add_stray_cat.desc: While looking at or holding a tamed Stray Cat, combine it with Killer Queen to gain additional skills. Stray Cats are created when an unworthy Cat is shot with a Stand Arrow to gain the Stand Virus effect and dies on a dirt-variant block. Stray Cat must be tamed with Raw Cod or Salmon to be used.
ability.sba.kq_bomb_bubble.desc: Fires an explosive air bubble that continuously travels in the direction faced by the user.
ability.sba.kq_bomb_bubble_redirect.desc: Causes the current Air Bubble to pursue a highlighted target as long a clear sightline exists between the user and target.
ability.sba.kq_arms_mode.desc: Hides your stand. Allows blocking, planting Primary Bombs and using Sheer Heart Attack, but prevents the use of some abilities, including basic stand attacks.
ability.sba.arms_mode.desc: Hide your stand. Replaces your attacks with up close brawling punching that disable shields like axes. You lose access to many of your abilities while this is toggled, but can use major abilities discretely.
ability.sba.mining.desc: Your stand has the capability to mine when holding attack. It is fast and clears out blocks. While sneaking, it does not destroy ore.
ability.sba.meteor_shower.desc: Draws meteors from the sky towards you. They are small and cause no terrain damage but pass through blocks and hit anything in between. They inflict bleed and good damage.If shifting they will go towards your feet.
ability.sba.big_meteor.desc: Draws a single large meteor from the sky towards you. Does terrain damage as it comes your way. If used in conjunction with Stand Targeting, it creates a bigger blast that could be used to gradually mine down. They inflict bleed 2 and very heavy damage.
ability.sba.stand_targeting.desc: Your stand floats very quickly to the spot you are looking at, and buries itself in the ground upon summoning a meteor, so the meteor heads to the stand instead of the user. You can now make meteors mine a designated space on the ground instead of relying on weird angles onto your body. The downside is your body is no longer protected.
ability.sba.stand_retrieving.desc: Makes your stand come back, making it so that meteors go back to falling towards you
ability.sba.desintegration.desc: This Stand adjusts the angle of entry of countless meteorites floating in space towards its user, drawing them towards Earth. The meteorites burn up just before touching the user, so they can never hit it.
ability.sba.meteor_tracking.desc: Toggle between meteor tracking on/off. When meteor tracking is on all meteors in the meteor shower will follow you.
ability.sba.forced_dissintegration.desc: Makes all current big meteors disintegrate. This move is useful to avoid destruction.
ability.sba.grab.desc: When in stand targeting mode if anyone gets close enough to planet waves they will get grabbed.
ability.sba.silver_chariot_statue_cuttin: Cuts a statue from a column of 3 stone blocks, if possible. Use the ability at the bottom of the blocks
Cuts a slab from a block, if possible.
Silver Chariot slashes with it's sword in stand attack range dealing small amount of damage, bleed along with destroying tall grass and fire.
ability.sba.silver_chariot_rapier_spin.d: Silver Chariot spins it's rapier and intercepts most projectiles, and dealing small damage to entities and large knockback.
ability.sba.silver_chariot_offhand_weapo: Silver Chariot renders the user's held item in it's offhand and attacks with it, if the user is not holding an item a final attack is instead charged.
ability.sba.silver_chariot_arm_summon.de: Renders Silver Chariot's main arm on the user's main arm, and the user can attack like they are holding a sword.
ability.sba.silver_chariot_armor_shed.de: Removes Silver Chariot's armor trading faster movements and attacks for decreased protection.
ability.sba.silver_chariot_self_grab.des: Silver Chariot grabs the user and the user can control Silver Chariot, if the attack button is pressed the user is thrown.
ability.sba.silver_chariot_rapier_shot.d: Silver Chariot shoots it's rapier dealing massive damage, bleed, knockback and shield break when hitting an enemy. Will reflect on a surface one time. Will prevent you from using the stand's offensive features for a certain amount of time.
ability.sba.silver_chariot_rapier_shot_p: Silver Chariot shoots it's rapier but does not reflect on hit surfaces and instead embeds itself and can be used as a platform.
ability.sba.silver_chariot_rapier_shot_s: Switch between the types of sword projectiles.
Enters control mode for Silver Chariot. When in control mode, entities that are behind the user will not be rendered for Silver Chariot.
ability.sba.silver_chariot_rapier_jab.de: Throws a jab directly in front of you. Hold it down for a 3 hit-combo!
ability.sba.silver_chariot_rapier_barrag: Trap your enemy in a flurry of blows, sending them flying at the end.
ability.sba.manhattan_premise.desc: Manhattan Transfer absorbs projectiles shot at it. So if you aim a bow or a firearm at it, it will hold onto that projectile and use it for shooting mobs.
ability.sba.manual_shooting.desc: There are two shooting modes: auto and manual. In auto mode, the stand will automatically redirect projectiles it stores at the closest moving entity, so long as the mob is in range. The range is indicated with a brighter highlight. In manual mode, you have to enter control mode, aim, and press attack to shoot the stored projectile.
ability.sba.control_mode.desc: If you are not controlling the stand, it will always move forwards, and if you enter control mode you can override it's movement direction. If you don't press any key or go out of control mode, it will go to the last direction you inputted. It cannot move while holding a projectile.
ability.sba.wind_vision.desc: Lets you see your stand's wind reading from your perspective, giving you identical visuals to control mode. It is useful if the stand sees something you cannot from its position.
ability.sba.bonus_damage.desc: When the stand redirects a bullet or other select projectiles, stand damage is added to the projectile.
ability.sba.wind_reading.desc: The stand senses entities that are moving or have recently moved. When you control the stand or turn on Wind Vision, only those mobs are visible, glowing and highlighted. You also see your circumstances with a greenish filter.
ability.sba.manhattan_dodge.desc: Your stand gets a quick burst of speed. Ideal for dodging stand projectiles, which are one of your greatest weakness
ability.sba.black_sabbath_premise.desc: Black Sabbath is an automatic stand that can only exist in shadows, and some moves are only locked when you are in the dark. When you find yourself in a dark place, you can open your bonus depot or start selecting enemies which Black Sabbath will hunt when those targets are in the dark.
ability.sba.black_sabbath_weakness.desc: Given the fact Black Sabbath can exist in dark places, he will become unable to operate when approaching light: if his storage is open or you are selecting a target, and you are in a light place, the move will be disabled; if Black Sabbath is hunting and is in light he will start burning, eventually he will die and your stand will get sealed!
ability.sba.black_sabbath_target_selecti: Summons Black Sabbath on your back and he will follow you, helping you to see better in the dark. In this mode you can select the targets which Black Sabbath will hunt down (see 'How to select and unselect targets?').
How to select and unselect targets?

When in selection mode, left click on a mob will select them, if you do it on a selected target they will be removed from the list, pressing again this skill once some entities are selected will confirm the list and it will send the stand and if you are sneaking and you press this skill when having some targets selected cancels the whole list. If the list is confirmed, pressing this skill while looking at and entity will remove them from the list and if you do this while sneaking all targets will be removed from the list, thus ending the hunt.
ability.sba.black_sabbath_inventory.desc: Black Sabbath emerges from the shadows and opens his mouth. You have nine slots in which you can put any item as long as it's not a Shulker Box and the item put in the first one will determine what Black Sabbath does to it's target once they're grabbed (see 'Attack Slot Mechanics')
Bites our finger, damaging you. In exchange you get a Lighter.
ability.sba.black_sabbath_lighter_mechan: The lighter item can be lit or unlit by right clicking it and can also be placed as a block. If the placed lighter is lit, it will emit some light and all entities which will trample on it and their witnesses will get automatically targeted by your stand. Entities also get targeted along with their witnesses when a player lights an unlit lighter. A lighter can also be put off if the dropped item or the player touches water or rain.
ability.sba.black_sabbath_attack_slot_me: The first item in the stand's mouth will determine what the stand does when grabbing a soul: items such as Arrows, Knives and Tridents will make the stand strafe and shoot said item, if it holds a weapon such as a Sword it will stab the soul a couple of times, if it has Food or a Potion it will feed it to the soul, if it holds a Bell it will continuously ring it, if it holds a Horn it will toot. If it holds a Stand Arrow...
ability.sba.diver_phase_punch.desc: Charge up a powerful blow! At maximum charge, your punches will go through multiple mobs, walls, and even through shields!
ability.sba.diver_submerge.desc: Submerge your stand into another person! Then, change their insides to suit you, whether that change is positive... or not.
ability.sba.diver_disassemble.desc: Break down a block into it's basic crafting components. This move only works on blocks that use 1 type of ingredient, don't create multiple blocks from crafting, and don't return items when being crafted.
ability.sba.diver_self_submerge.desc: Submerge your stand into yourself. This lets you toggle redirection early, and lets you apply effects on yourself
ability.sba.diver_selection.desc: Open a UI where you can pick an effect to apply to others. There are a total of 3 positive, 3 negative, and 2 neutral effects.
ability.sba.diver_redirection.desc: This move lets you toggle if you want to take damage for the person you're submerged in, or not
ability.sba.diver_store.desc: Kick a surface to store energy in it. Once an enemy is close enough then... RELEASE!
ability.sba.diver_release_toggle.desc: Toggle between traps triggering automatically when stepped on, or manually through Sneak + Ability 2. Automatic releases take longer to activate when stepped on by players.
ability.sba.diver_cancel_store.desc: Delete all active traps on automatic mode. On manual mode, trigger any traps that have an entity on them, including players, instantly.
ability.sba.diver_zip.desc: Your stand dives into the ground and zips you around! While in this mode, you can't do anything but move around and 1 hit knocks you out.
ability.sba.diver_wall_zip.desc: Attach to a wall and zip around. While in this mode, you can't do anything but move around and 1 hit knocks you out.
ability.sba.diver_workstation.desc: Your stand dives into your items and changes them, allowing it emulate the functions of various workstations.
ability.sba.diver_limb_platform.desc: Limbs emerge from the walls and ground as your stand dives inside them. This move allows you to climb on the limbs of your stand, and lets others do the same. The limbs also reduce fall damage, and up to 4 can be placed at a time.
ability.sba.diver_ground_dive.desc: Your stand dives into the ground, letting you control it! Unleash a powerful barrage by attacking.
ability.sba.diver_detection.desc: Toggles Diver Down to look for any ores underground, highlighting them for you.
ability.sba.diver_grab.desc: Diver Down grabs all nearby items off the ground and brings them back to you.
ability.sba.diver_chest.desc: Diver Down opens the closest chest and brings items to and from your inventory.
ability.sba.diver_recall.desc: Recall Diver Down back to you.
ability.sba.lyin_eyes_map.desc: The nematodes show you a layout of the blocks around you. The nematodes will also highlight enemies and containers, like chests, for you.
ability.sba.lyin_eyes_tension_sensor.des: The nematodes highlight enemies through walls. Hostile mobs are highlighted red, neutral mobs are yellow, and passive mobs are green. Enemies that are low are highlighted differently.
ability.sba.lyin_eyes_inventory.desc: The nematodes gather around to show you what items a player has in their inventory.
ability.sba.lyin_eyes_callout.desc: Interacting with a villager might cause them to be revealed as a liar. Using Tension Sensor, you can detect those that are lying to you. Interact with them again while in Tension Sensor to call them out, giving all Lyin' Eyes users permanent trade discounts. Nitwits will throw whatever items they have on hand out of fear. Don't go lying.
ability.sba.gold_experience_life_punch.d: Your stand infused whatever you hit with life. This punch can act as bonemeal, make trees wilt and explode, or make your enemy's senses go berserk.
ability.sba.gold_experience_dna_creation: Use the DNA from an item to create a new lifeform from the cells. This mob takes time to grow, but is permanent
ability.sba.gold_experience_bramble_trap: Grow a bunch of bushes from the ground. These bushes won't damage enemies, but they will slow them. Walking through the bushes destroys them.
ability.sba.gold_experience_vine_climb.d: Grow vines on a wall and climb on them. These vines stay for a while, allowing others to climb on them as well.
ability.sba.gold_experience_heal.desc: Grow parts of something to heal it. Getting healed by this move makes your regenerate health over time, but getting hit ends it early. Tap the move to use it on yourself, hold to use it on others.
ability.sba.gold_experience_violent_bram: Grow brambles out of the ground in a line. If these brambles hit an enemy, they will take damage and bleed.
ability.sba.gold_experience_lifeform_sel: Opens a selection screen to choose an animal to create. The screen gives detailed descriptions of every animal.
ability.sba.gold_experience_lifeform_cre: Create a mob that you chose with Lifeform Selection. This mob will reflect all damage done to it, except from you. Some items have special interactions when mobs revert.
ability.sba.gold_experience_item_throw.d: Grabs the item you are holding in your inventory to throw. Upon landing, the item transforms into your selected lifeform.
Grow a barren tree from the ground. This tree lets you ride on it to the top, or parkour up it's branches. Enemies that hit the tree will have the damage reflected back to them.
ability.sba.gold_experience_item_imbue.d: This move opens a menu that lets you imbue an item with life energy. This lets you give unique properties to the item, such as being able to turn the item into an animal, root enemies in place, and disguise the item. Only 1 item may be imbued at a time.
Gold Experience scans the nearby area for lifeforms. If someone has an imbued item on them, you will be able to see their aura from a lot further away. The aura reading persists until you stop blocking.
ability.sba.gold_experience_double_punch: Throw out a 1-2 punch. This does as much damage as the last hit in a punch string, but deals more knockback.
ability.sba.gold_experience_requiem.desc: Fill up your resolve bar by performing various tasks in order to evolve your stand to a temporary higher form. It's abilities are unknown even to you, the user.
ability.sba.emperor_shoot.desc: Shoot a bullet from the emperor.
ability.sba.emperor_heat.desc: This takes over your experience bar. As you shoot the emperor, it ticks up, and once it is high enough you will not be able to shoot.
ability.sba.emperor_squint.desc: Slight zoom, not very pronounced, also slows you down a little.
ability.sba.emperor_single.desc: Shoot one shot every click, it takes a lower amount of heat.
ability.sba.emperor_triple.desc: Shoot three shots per click, it takes a higher amount of heat.
ability.sba.emperor_control_mode_on.desc: The bullets you fire home to your crosshair while turned on.
ability.sba.emperor_auto_mode_on.desc: The bullets you fire home to the closest mob to the bullet.
ability.sba.emperor_speed_up.desc: Your bullets speed up as you hold this ability. The faster a bullet goes, the more damage it does.
ability.sba.emperor_speed_down.desc: Your bullets slow down as you hold this ability. The slower a bullet goes, the less damage it does.
ability.sba.changing_stance.desc: Rotate between the 4 different stances, ground, neutral, knockback and redstone
ability.sba.ground_stance.desc: Redirect almost all attacks taken to nearby blocks, slowly breaking the blocks beneath you
ability.sba.neutral_stance.desc: Makes you immune to almost all attacks
ability.sba.knockback_stance.desc: Protects you from almost all attacks and make you take double the knockback of them
ability.sba.redstone_stance.desc: Redirects almost all attacks taken to nearby blocks as redstone signal that can be captured by observers, sculk, tnt, iron doors and redstone lamps
ability.sba.activate_invincibility.desc: Activates the chosen stance, you can't move, use items, place blocks, heal or attacks in this state
ability.sba.food_energize.desc: Energizes the food are holding with curing powers.
ability.sba.palm_read.desc: Press If near a mob, reads their palm which displays their hunger and potion effects.
ability.sba.whitesnake_chop.desc: Hold and release within the threshold to unleash a devastating chop, or full charge it for a powerful punch.
ability.sba.whitesnake_acid_toss.desc: Toss hallucinatory acid that spreads across floors and walls which inflicts Hallucination overtime.
ability.sba.whitesnake_melting_mode.desc: While in control mode, you can enter melting mode. Your stand slithers along the ground, walls, and ceiling, leaving a trail of its acid wherever it goes. Holding space in this mode lets you hover temporarily.
ability.sba.whitesnake_control_mode.desc: Control Whitesnake directly while leaving your body behind.
ability.sba.whitesnake_auto_mode.desc: Make Whitesnake autonomously pursue your last attacked target. You may also command Whitesnake.
ability.sba.whitesnake_auto_mode_move.de: While in Auto Mode, order Whitesnake to travel to the targeted location and stop attacking its current target.
While in Auto Mode, order Whitesnake to attack the entity you are looking at.
Toggle whether Whitesnake follows you in Auto Mode.
ability.sba.whitesnake_auto_mode_attack_: Toggle whether Whitesnake automatically attacks whoever you hit last in Auto Mode.
ability.sba.whitesnake_time_spark.desc: Accelerate the time of whatever is directly infront of you.
ability.sba.whitesnake_disguise.desc: While in control mode, use this ability to enter a player's username to give Whitesnake the appearance of that player.
ability.sba.whitesnake_inventory.desc: Open Whitesnake's inventory. The first slot holds nothing, the second slot can hold pistols. The last 7 slots can store discs or ammunition.
sba.diver_down.disguise.title: Reconstructory Disguise
sba.whitesnake.disguise.title: Hallucinatory Disguise
sba.whitesnake.disguise.not_found: That Java Edition account could not be found.
ability.purple_haze.punch.desc: Throws a punch directly in front of you. Hold it down for a 3 hit-combo! Be careful, if the last hit of a combo connects a capsule will break.
ability.purple_haze.capsule_throw.desc: Launch a capsule on a short distance, it breaks on impact. When the capsule breaks, it takes a very short moment before spreading the virus into the air, infecting everything in a short range around where the capsule broke.
ability.purple_haze.punch_barrage.desc: Trap your enemy in a flurry of blows, breaking a capsule and sending them flying at the end.
ability.purple_haze.kick_barrage.desc: A faster charging barrage that does not disable enemy attacks. It doesnt break a capsule at the end, resulting in a safer but weaker alternative to the punch barrage.
ability.purple_haze.daily_capsule_rechar: At the start of each day, all your capsules are reloaded, putting you back to the maximum amount.
ability.purple_haze.distortion.desc: Bite a pod, hurting you and and destroying the pod while giving you immunity to the virus for a small amount of time. Once the immunity ends, any virus infection will be cleared.
ability.purple_haze.virus_spit.desc: While under the effect of the virus immunity, spit forward the contents of the bitten pod to inflict the distortion virus to the enemy. However this will remove the effect of the immunity without clearing infections.
ability.purple_haze.haze_switch.desc: Change between the 2 modes of virus: Purple and Distortion.
ability.purple_haze.purple_smoke.desc: A ruthless virus unleashed from Purple Haze's capsules that destroys anything living including you. Haze cloud duration is drastically reduced by light exposure being sterilized in no time when exposed to direct sunlight
ability.purple_haze.distortion_smoke.des: Virus begins to consume itself dealing more damage as time goes on. It deals less damage overall to opponents while dealing considerably less to you. As a result of the virus eating everything including itself it will also eat through the duration of other status effects.
ability.purple_haze.strangle.desc: Purple Haze charges up for a brief period before launching forward, choking any enemy it hits and holding them in place for a few seconds.
ability.purple_haze.falling_hit.desc: While falling Purple Haze prepares a punch, which on landing does a damaging shockwave and breaks a capsule. Also acts as a way to reduce fall damage
ability.purple_haze.capsule_count.desc: Displays the number of remaining capsule when active, so you can more easily track it. You can have a maximum of 6 capsules at a time
ability.purple_haze.capsule_advanced_rec: Every certain amount of time pods will recharge. This doesnt replace normal recharging, at the start of the day they still get replenished.
ability.purple_haze.ph_heavy_punch.desc: Charge up a punch that on contact with blocks or entities breaks a capsule.
ability.purple_haze.ph_heavy_kick.desc: Wind up an uninterruptable kick that deals knockback, useful for launching into virus clouds.

gamerule.sbaStandGriefingObtainment.desc: Controls whether or not stands can obtain blocks from griefing
gamerule.sbaMonsterStandFireSpreads.desc: Controls whether or not monsters with Magician's Red spread fire.
gamerule.sbaStandLeveling.description: Whether or not stands start off maxed
gamerule.sbaKeepStandsOnDeath.descriptio: Whether or not you lose/drop stands when you die
gamerule.sbaStandRedstoneInterference.de: Whether or not stands can interact with levers, redstone, etc.
gamerule.sbaMobGrabbing.description: Whether or not stands grab and carry mobs
gamerule.sbaSpawnWorthyMobs.description: Whether or not mobs can spawn worthy of stands
gamerule.sbaSpawnStandUserMobs.descripti: Whether or not mobs can spawn with stands
gamerule.sbaRoadRollerBreakIce.descripti: Whether or not road rollers break fragile blocks
gamerule.sbaLoseFateOnDeath.description: Whether or not you lose your fate like vampirism on death
