sba.diver_workbench.crafting.desc: Diver Down emulates a crafting table.
sba.diver_workbench.smithing.desc: Diver Down emulates a smithing table.
sba.diver_affliction.diver_legs.desc: Diver Down replaces the legs of the target. While Diver Down is submerged inside the target, they will gain increased jump height and auto step.
sba.diver_affliction.effect_cure.desc: Diver Down purges the body of all negative effects from the inside out. This only works on effects that can be cleared by milk.
sba.diver_affliction.diver_arms.desc: Diver Down replaces the arms of the target. While Diver Down is submerged inside the target, they will gain increased mining speed and faster attack cooldowns.
sba.diver_affliction.disguise.desc: Change the bone structure of the current target, disguising them into whatever user you want. You can toggle showing armor on or off, and the move also works on corpses. Using this move again clears the disguise.
sba.diver_affliction.embed_potion.desc: Use a currently held potion or bucketed mob and embed it directly inside the target. Potions last longer when embeded this way, while bucketed mobs pacify enemies.
sba.diver_affliction.ribcage_trap.desc: Force the enemy to walk in a straight line, then when they see an enemy, release the trap! Against players and bosses, this move will only force them to walk.
sba.diver_affliction.bone_bomb.desc: Explode the head of the target, causing bones to launch from them towards the nearest enemy. Against players and bosses this move will blind them.
sba.diver_affliction.spring_legs.desc: Quickly break down the enemies flesh and bones and reassemble them, causing them to bounce around uncontrollably.
sba.gold_experience_animal.butterfly.des: Flies to where your curser is pointed at and stops once it hits something.
sba.gold_experience_animal.bee.desc: Flies to the last target that you hit, or who hit you. Reverts back into an item upon contact.
sba.gold_experience_animal.bat.desc: Bats will find the closest entity and fly erraticaly in their face to bait reflection hits.
sba.gold_experience_animal.fish.desc: Swims in a straight line based on where you're looking when it spawned. You can interact with the fish to have it carry you. Riding the fish lets you control it by looking around.
sba.gold_experience_animal.pirahna.desc: Rushes to the last enemy you hit, or who hit you, and bites them, inflicting bleed.
sba.gold_experience_animal.snake.desc: Rushes to the last enemy you hit, or who hit you, and bites them, inflicting poison.
sba.gold_experience_animal.frog.desc: Pulls in the closest enemy within 10 blocks using it's tongue.
sba.gold_experience_animal.fox.desc: Finds nearby items and fetches them for you.
sba.gold_experience_item_imbue.animal.de: Transforms into an animal when used.
Disguises the held item as this item.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.sight.desc: Takes away eyesight from those who rely on vision after it pops, lasts a few seconds.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.sound.desc: Turns areas into sound-free zones, absorbs all sound and sound based attacks until it pops.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.friction.desc: Takes friction from the ground making it slippery. Can also take friction from a mob to make it slippery on any block
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.items.desc: Picks up items and brings them back to you.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.mobs.desc: Captures small mobs and brings them to you.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.oxygen.desc: Takes air out of the lungs of a mob, such that if they are underwater, they begin to drown. Also can drag oxygen from the air or magma blocks into the water to restore your own oxygen. Can also be used to put out fires, and take fires away from mobs, putting them elsewhere.
sba.soft_and_wet_plunder.moisture.desc: Captures liquids or gasoline, so they can easily be moved around. Can also move around blood that is on the ground.

config.sba.timeSkipRange.name: Time Skip Range
config.sba.timeSkipRange.desc: How far entities get skipped. The effect and sounds play 25 blocks further than this as padding for people witnessing it. This could be laggy if you drastically increase the range so I would recommend avoiding that.
config.sba.timeEraseBlocks.name: Render TE Blocks
config.sba.timeEraseBlocks.desc: If blocks in time erase should render.
config.sba.standShowName.name: Stands Show Their Name
config.sba.standShowName.desc: If stands should show their nametag. Intended for people that have difficulties to identify stands cause of colorblindess.
config.sba.whiteListModdedMobs.name: Whitelist Modded Mobs
config.sba.whiteListModdedMobs.desc: By default, d4c creates parallel mobs for modded mobs with world merging. It operates through a blacklist in the advanced config. Turning this on makes it a whitelist in case you want to keep these parallel mobs strictly vanilla to avoid conflicts.
config.sba.blacklistHighHealthMobs.name: Ban High HP Mobs
config.sba.blacklistHighHealthMobs.desc: Automatically prevents high health mobs from being parallel versions in the interest of avoiding weird boss interactions for mobs that mods didn't do their diligence and add the forge or fabric boss tag to.
config.sba.enableDaySkip.name: Day Skip
config.sba.enableDaySkip.desc: Enable to make the sun go by at 100 ticks (5 seconds) globally. Off by default.
config.sba.blocksCancelEpitaph2.name: Blocks Stop Epitaph
config.sba.blocksCancelEpitaph2.desc: By default placing blocks stops your projection so you can't skip someone into traps or hazards.
config.sba.freeTimeSkip.name: Free Time Skip
config.sba.freeTimeSkip.desc: Enable to be able to skip while using items or attacks.
config.sba.skipPastDeath.name: Fake Death Skip
config.sba.skipPastDeath.desc: Makes your fated self play a fake death message and potentially drop fake items based on gamerule.
config.sba.dropMode.name: Drop Mode
config.sba.dropMode.desc: 0: Parallel Mobs drop nothing, 1: Parallel Monsters drop experience, 2: Parallel Mobs drop experience, 3: Parallel Mobs drop loot and experience
config.sba.blinkWithCamo.name: Blink With Camo
config.sba.blinkWithCamo.desc: Turn off to make the vampire camo move not blink if it somehow makes you uncomfortable in some way.
config.sba.noGlaiveDuringPunchRecharge.d: Makes glaives not work while on punch cooldown. This prevents the scuffed strategy of applying pressure to melee users to recharge stand punches.
config.sba.enableCKB.name: Enable Stand
config.sba.enableCKB.desc: Turn the stand on or off. If off, the stand disc will not work or be in arrow/mob pools no matter what.
config.sba.doNotHurtMeBaseCD.name: Cower Cooldown
config.sba.doNotHurtMeBaseCD.desc: This cooldown appears when your counter fails, or between non-acted upon counters.
config.sba.doNotHurtMeRewindCD.name: Cower Success CD
config.sba.doNotHurtMeRewindCD.desc: This cooldown appears when you restore health with your counter.
config.sba.timeSkipCooldown.name: Time Skip CD
config.sba.timeSkipCooldown.desc: This cooldown for time skip in ticks.
config.sba.enableEpitaphPreSkip.name: Epitaph Non-Skip
config.sba.enableEpitaphPreSkip.desc: Enables using epitaph even with time skip unavailable. This is visually confusing but a highly requested feature.
config.sba.predictIdles.name: Predict Idles
config.sba.predictIdles.desc: Randomizes movement between idle mobs via epitaph and time skip. This creates a more lively movement, but if you have other mods that cause conflict or only want to read the future in a purely literal sense, disable this.
config.sba.epitaphCooldown.name: Epitaph CD
config.sba.epitaphInterrupt.name: Epitaph Interrupt
config.sba.epitaphInterrupt.desc: Should being attacked interrupt epitaph? For balancing.
config.sba.epitaphDuration.name: Epitaph Duration
config.sba.epitaphDuration.desc: How long in ticks does epitaph last? (20 ticks = 1 second)
config.sba.timeEraseDuration.name: Time Erase Duration
config.sba.timeEraseDuration.desc: How long in ticks does max level time erase last? (20 ticks = 1 second)
config.sba.timeEraseMinimumCooldown.name: TE Min Cooldown
config.sba.timeEraseMinimumCooldown.desc: How many ticks of cooldown are guaranteed for time erase? (20 ticks = 1 second)
config.sba.additionalCooldownPerSecondsU: How many ticks of cooldown per second spent? (20 ticks = 1 second)
config.sba.additionalCooldownFromPlayerR: If you run far enough in pvp during TE this cooldown is added. (20 ticks = 1 second)
config.sba.cooldownSplit.name: Cooldown Sync
config.sba.cooldownSplit.desc: Time Erase and Time Skip put each other on cooldown so they can't be chained.
config.sba.postPunishDelay.name: Punish Delay CD
config.sba.postPunishDelay.desc: How long your rules go on cooldown in general after stealing memories.
config.sba.mountingHorsesInCreativeTames: If you mount a horse in creative mode, you instantly tame it.
config.sba.bleedRemovesStrength.name: Bleed Removes Strength
config.sba.bleedRemovesStrength.desc: Whether bleed removes the strength potion effect initially upon being applied.
config.sba.hexTwoSealsPotions.name: Banish Blocks Potions
config.sba.hexTwoSealsPotions.desc: Whether banish prevents drinking and splashing potions while applied
config.sba.meleeSwapPenalty.name: Melee Swap Penalty
config.sba.meleeSwapPenalty.desc: If attacking with melee slows down your stand punch recharge. Reduces toxic hugging in pvp and forces people to use their brains more.
config.sba.bonusStandDmgByMaxLevel.name: Bonus Levelup Damage
config.sba.bonusStandDmgByMaxLevel.desc: By default stands don't get any bonus damage, because JoJo is not an RPG series. But if you want to turn the game into an RPG, this option is on the table. A percentage of damage increase for all stands, distributed across their levelups. If you set it to 100, you will do double damage by the max level.
config.sba.standExperienceNeededForLevel: Multiplies the amount of experience needed to level up. Increasing this number makes levelups take longer, and vice versa.
config.sba.enableStandLeveling.name: Enable Stand Leveling
config.sba.enableStandLeveling.desc: Stand Leveling is for unlocking skins and skills
config.sba.enablePickyIconRendering.name: Enable Icon Cooldown Hiding
config.sba.enablePickyIconRendering.desc: Hides ability icons when all of your cooldowns are off.
config.sba.opacityOfPlayerStandArms.name: Player Stand Arms
config.sba.opacityOfPlayerStandArms.desc: The opacity of first person stand arms (as in hidden mode king crimson punches, for example).
config.sba.opacityOfPlayerBarrageArms.de: The opacity of first person barrage arms coming from the player (as in vampirism or hamon rushes).
config.sba.spiritOutInterruption.name: Full Spirit Interrupt
config.sba.spiritOutInterruption.desc: By default, you need your powers activated (or to be powerless) to interrupt attacks. This mechanic is called full spirit interrupt, and serves to make the interrupting mechanic more satisfying. Turn off this setting for classic sba interrupts.
config.sba.standThrownEntityFallDamageIm: By default, throwing an entity gives them brief fall damage immunity ticks, so you need to throw them far down something to get hurt in this manner.
config.sba.enableBowlerHatRender.name: Enable Bowler Hat Render
config.sba.enableBowlerHatRender.desc: Whether or not the bowler hat renders on your head while holding it.
config.sba.vampireLeveling.name: Enable Vampire Leveling
config.sba.vampireLeveling.desc: If this config is set to false, vampires start with everything.
config.sba.mobsDropParts.name: Chimera Parts Drop
config.sba.mobsDropParts.desc: By default, killing certain mobs as a vampire gives you their grafting parts.

config.sba.cinderellaWeight.name: Cinderella Salon Weight
config.sba.cinderellaWeight.desc: Adjust the weight to give it more priority over other modded structures.

config.sba.meteoriteWeight.desc: Adjust the weight to give it more priority over other modded structures.

config.sba.anubisChanceDry.desc: The above but in dry locations. Default is none.
config.sba.beetleArrowChanceDry.name: Beetle Arrow Chance
config.sba.beetleArrowChanceDry.desc: Changes the weighting of the loot. Think of it like adding an extra, identical, item to the possible options. Stand Arrows appear in drier locations, such as desert wells, pyramids, and warm ocean ruins.

config.sba.beetleArrowChanceNotDry.desc: The above but in other locations. Default is none.

config.sba.maxPlunderBubbleTravelDistanc: How far plunder bubbles can go before popping, the default is 100 blocks.
config.sba.moistureWithStandGriefingTake: Whether or not with Stand Griefing off, you can take liquid source blocks. Useful for irrigation.
config.sba.moisturePoppingPlacesLiquidsI: Lets you pop moisture bubbles in the air to place water in the air. By default this is off, and replaced with a simple splash, because it could be used for easy griefing.
config.sba.frictionStopsJumping.name: Friction Stops Jumping
config.sba.frictionStopsJumping.desc: When friction is stolen, the ability to jump is lost too. This is off by default because it can be frustrating and limits possibility benefits.
config.sba.directFrictionStopsJumping.de: The same as above, but only applies to entities hit directly by friction bubbles.
config.sba.frictionStealingDurationInTic: How long you take friction off of the ground, by default lasts for 200 ticks, or 10 seconds.
config.sba.playerFrictionStealingDuratio: Same as above but for players.
config.sba.bossesCannotLoseFriction.name: Bosses Can Not Lose Friction
config.sba.bossesCannotLoseFriction.desc: Boss type mobs will not lose friction if it is plundered from them or their surroundings.
config.sba.bossesCannotLoseSight.name: Bosses Can Not Lose Sight
config.sba.bossesCannotLoseSight.desc: Boss type mobs will not lose eyesight if it is plundered from them.
config.sba.ticksBetweenSightStealsOnSame: The amount of ticks between stealing sight on the same mob or player. By default it is 300 ticks, or 15 seconds.
config.sba.sightStealingDurationOnMobsIn: The length of sight stealing on mobs. By default it is 200 ticks, or 10 seconds.
config.sba.sightStealingDurationOnPlayer: The length of sight stealing on players. By default it is 100 ticks, or 5 seconds.
config.sba.primaryPlunderBubbleLifespanI: How long all normal bubbles last before they pop. The default is 400 ticks, or 20 seconds.
config.sba.itemBubbleLifespanInTicks.des: How long item launching bubbles last before they pop.
config.sba.sizeOfMobBubbleMobsStolen.des: The max height of mobs that can be taken on a joy ride with mob plunder.
config.sba.widthOfMobBubbleMobsStolen.de: The max width of mobs that can be taken on a joy ride with mob plunder.
config.sba.maxExplosiveBubbleTravelDista: How far away an explosive bubble can go before it disintegrates automatically, by default after 30 blocks it goes away. This is valuable for clearing bubbles shot straight into the air.
config.sba.explosiveBubbleShootSpeedMult: A multiplier for how fast explosive bubbles travel when shot. Raise this to make them faster, lower this to make them slower.
config.sba.heatGainedPerShot.name: Heat Per Shot
config.sba.heatGainedPerShot.desc: The amount of heat gained per explosive bubble shot in shooting mode. The default is 2499 gained per shot. Lowering this could mean more bubbles shot in one continuous attack, the default allows 4 per burst.
config.sba.heatTickDownRate.name: Heat Tick Down Rate
config.sba.heatTickDownRate.desc: The amount of heat reduced per tick in shooting mode. Lower this to reload your bubble shooting faster. The default is 50 points per tick.
config.sba.heatTickDownPauseLength.name: Heat Pause Length
config.sba.heatTickDownPauseLength.desc: After shooting in shooting mode, pauses for 20 ticks (1 second) by default before the meter starts ticking down. If you want more continuous shots, lower this.
config.sba.explosiveSpinMeterGainedPerSh: The explosive spin meter gained per explosive bubble shot. If you increase this, you reach go beyond faster, and vice versa.
config.sba.explosiveSpinMeterGainedPerHi: The explosive spin meter gained per explosive bubble shot. If you increase this, you reach go beyond faster, and vice versa.
config.sba.explosiveSpinMeterTickDownRat: The meter that fills to put you in explosive spin mode slowly drains away passively. Decrease this if you only want the meter to build, not to drain. The default is 5 per tick.
config.sba.explosiveSpinModeTickDownRate: How fast the Explosive Spin ticks away, increase this to lose it faster when reached. The default is 100 per tick.
config.sba.goBeyondLifespanInTicks.name: Go Beyond Lifespan
config.sba.goBeyondLifespanInTicks.desc: How many ticks go beyond tries to chase its target until it fizzles out. By default it is 300 ticks, or 15 seconds.
config.sba.goBeyondTicksUntilItCanHit.de: The amount of ticks after launching go beyond before it can hit a mob. By default it is 26 ticks, or over a second. The reason this exists is to prevent walking into someone and then firing it point blank.
config.sba.waterShieldDurationInTicks.de: In ticks, how long the situational water shield lasts. By default it lasts for a full second, 20 ticks, which is essentially a very generous parry window.
config.sba.bubbleBarrageRecoilCooldown.d: The cooldown if your bubble barrage is interrupted. The default is 35 ticks, nearly 2 seconds.
config.sba.kickMinimumCooldown.name: Kick Minimum Cooldown
config.sba.kickMinimumCooldown.desc: The minimum cooldown of the kick attack, the rest of the cooldown is based on charge time. The default is 20 ticks, or 1 second.
config.sba.bubbleScaffoldingCooldown.des: The cooldown between creating bubble scaffold walkways. If you lower it too much, you can just loop it and walk across the sky forever. Thus, the default is 240 ticks. or 12 seconds.
config.sba.waterShieldCooldown.name: Water Shield Cooldown
config.sba.waterShieldCooldown.desc: The cooldown of the situational water shield ability, if you have a water bottle to use. The default is 40 ticks, or 2 seconds.
config.sba.waterShieldBucketCooldown.des: The cooldown of the situational water shield ability, if you have a bucket to use. The default is 40 ticks, or 2 seconds.

config.sba.abilityIconHudIsAnimated.desc: Whether or not of the ability icons that slide in when your stand/powers are active actually slide, or just jump immediately to the spot.

config.sba.whiteAlbumMaxAcceleration.des: How many ticks of building speed? 100 ticks = 5 seconds of uninterrupted running.
config.sba.sunArmorDamage.name: Sun Armor Damage
config.sba.sunArmorDamage.desc: White Album's suit lets vampires temporarily exist under the sun. Lower this to make it last longer, or raise it very high to make the suit shatter under sunlight immediately.

config.sba.blockFreezeRadius.desc: What is the radius of blocks that white album can convert into frozen blocks with its frozen world ability?
config.sba.freezesSurfaceWater.name: Block Freeze Water
config.sba.freezesSurfaceWater.desc: Enable frozen world to coat the raging seas in ice.
config.sba.freezesGrassv2.name: Freezes Grass
config.sba.freezesGrassv2.desc: If disabled, white album won't replace grass and tallgrass, and other non-air blocks, even with stand griefing on.
config.sba.freezesSnow.name: Freezes Snow
config.sba.freezesSnow.desc: If disabled, white album won't replace snow.

config.sba.maxMagiciansRedFlames.desc: The maximum amount of flames you can create. It is capped at 100 by default for server performance reasons, as the stand fire is a block entity.
The max distance you can be away from your flames before they dissapear. The default is 100 blocks.
config.sba.magiciansRedFurnaceTicks.name: Furnace Ticks
config.sba.magiciansRedFurnaceTicks.desc: The duration that you can set a furnace on fire for free, negative one disables it. by default it lasts 1100 ticks or 55 seconds.
config.sba.lifeTrackerManualPushing.name: Life Tracker Pushing
config.sba.lifeTrackerManualPushing.desc: Off by default, but lets you manually push the life tracker around instead of it staying in a fixed spot.
config.sba.magicianKickMinimumCooldown.d: The minimum cooldown of the kick attack, the rest of the cooldown is based on charge time. The default is 20 ticks, or 1 second.
config.sba.snapFireAwayCooldown.name: Snap Cooldown
config.sba.snapFireAwayCooldown.desc: The cooldown of snapping your fire away, the default is 20 ticks, or 1 second.
config.sba.igniteFireCooldown.name: Ignition Cooldown
config.sba.igniteFireCooldown.desc: The cooldown for the ignite ability which acts like a flint and steel, the default is 20 ticks or 1 second.
config.sba.lashCooldown.name: Lash Cooldown
config.sba.lashCooldown.desc: The cooldown before the lash attack string resets after doing the first two attacks, the default is 37 ticks, nearly two seconds.
config.sba.lastLashInStringCooldown.name: Last Lash Cooldown
config.sba.lastLashInStringCooldown.desc: The last lash attack in your normal attack string, by default the cooldown is 60 ticks or 3 seconds.
config.sba.redBindFailOrMissCooldown.des: The cooldown of Red Bind if it fizzles out or fails, or is interrupted. The default is 60 ticks, or 3 seconds.
The cooldown of Red Bind if you release it manually, the default is 20 ticks, or 1 second.
config.sba.redBindDazeAttackCooldown.des: If you left click during Red Bind to do a daze attack, it goes on this cooldown.
config.sba.ankhSuccessCooldown.name: Crossfire Cooldown
config.sba.ankhSuccessCooldown.desc: The cooldown for crossfire hurricane if it succeeds, default is 120 ticks, or 6 seconds.
config.sba.ankhConcealedCooldown.name: Concealed Cooldown
config.sba.ankhConcealedCooldown.desc: The cooldown for flame concealment in blocks, default is 100 ticks, or 5 seconds.
config.sba.ankhHiddenCooldown.name: Variation Cooldown
config.sba.ankhHiddenCooldown.desc: The cooldown for crossfire hurricane variation, default is 100 ticks, or 5 seconds.
config.sba.ankhFailCooldown.name: Ankh Failure Cooldown
config.sba.ankhFailCooldown.desc: If your ankh is extinguished or expires, it goes on this cooldown for a default of 80 ticks, or 4 seconds.
config.sba.hurricaneSpecialCooldown.name: Hurricane Special Cooldown
config.sba.hurricaneSpecialCooldown.desc: The cooldown for crossfire hurricane special, by default it is 600 ticks, or 30 seconds, because it is powerful.
config.sba.projectileBurnCooldown.name: Projectile Burn Cooldown
config.sba.projectileBurnCooldown.desc: The cooldown for projectile burn, by default it is 100 ticks, or 5 seconds.
config.sba.flameCrashCooldown.name: Flame Crash Cooldown
config.sba.flameCrashCooldown.desc: The cooldown for starting flame crash, regardless of its success. The default is 400 ticks, or 20 seconds.
config.sba.magiciansRedFireballsWindup.d: How long it takes to charge up the fireball barrage attack, in ticks.
config.sba.magiciansRedFlamethrowerWindu: How long it takes to charge up the flamethrower attack, in ticks.
config.sba.corpseDamageMultOnPlayers.des: How much damage the corpses deals to players, and potentially stand user mobs. The base of 100 means x1.0, so at 0.5 the damage is halved and at 300 the damage is tripled for instance.
config.sba.corpseDamageMultOnMobs.name: Mob Damage Multiplier
config.sba.corpseDamageMultOnMobs.desc: How much damage the corpses deals to every other mob, same math as above.
config.sba.villagerCorpseProjectileResil: Villager corpses take reduced damage by projectiles. The default is 0.5 (50 percent). If you increase it to one they take full damage, if you decrease it they take even less.
config.sba.fogAndPilotRange.name: Fog and Control Range
config.sba.fogAndPilotRange.desc: How far the fog extends, and how far you can control justice in control mode.
config.sba.maxCorpses.name: Max Corpses
config.sba.maxCorpses.desc: The amount of corpses you can activate at once. The default is 12, for balance in pvp reasons and server performance reasons. But in canon, according to JoJo 6251 (a guide written by Araki), Justice can control over a thousand corpses at once.
config.sba.standUserMobMinionCount.name: Enemy User Max Corpses
config.sba.standUserMobMinionCount.desc: The same as above, but for enemy stand users. By default it is 5 as to not overwhelm.
config.sba.corpsesUseOwnerTeam.name: Corpses Use Owner Team
config.sba.corpsesUseOwnerTeam.desc: Enables corpses sharing the scoreboard team of their owners.
Enables the ability for corpses to be given items by sneak right clicking them.
config.sba.zombieCorpsesCanMineAndPlaceB: Enables the ability for zombie corpses to mine and place blocks with their given items, if directed at a block in justice control mode.
config.sba.fogCloneCooldown.name: Fog Clone Cooldown
config.sba.fogCloneCooldown.desc: Change the cooldown of fog clone creation, by default the cooldown is 700 ticks (35 seconds) because the ability is extremely powerful defensively and lets you eat with little consequence.
config.sba.fogChainCooldown.name: Fog Chain Cooldown
config.sba.fogChainCooldown.desc: Change the cooldown of fog chains, by default the cooldown is 80 (4 seconds).
config.sba.phantomCorpseSpeed.name: Phantom Riding Speed
config.sba.phantomCorpseSpeed.desc: Change how fast the speed of phantom mounts are, it is 0.83 by default. Change to zero to disable the ability to ride phantom corpses in general.
config.sba.enableFogBlockInventory.name: Enable Fog Inventory
config.sba.enableFogBlockInventory.desc: Enables or disables the fog inventory skill. If the inventory is giving you trouble due to mod interactions or there are any other modded server issues with it, you can turn it off disabling it and its related code.
config.sba.attackSpeedBuff.name: Attack Speed Buff
config.sba.attackSpeedBuff.desc: Increases the speed of swinging weapons with justice active. By default, the stand increases your attack speed by 30%.
config.sba.miningSpeedBuff.name: Mining Speed Buff
config.sba.miningSpeedBuff.desc: Increases the speed of breaking blocks with justice active. By default, the stand increases your mining speed by 30%.
config.sba.miningSpeedBuffWhite.name: Mining Speed Buff
config.sba.miningSpeedBuffWhite.desc: Increases the speed of breaking blocks with white album active. By default, the stand increases your mining speed by 15%.

config.sba.bonusMobDMGWhite.name: Bonus Mob Damage

config.sba.numberOfYapLines.desc: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.

config.sba.numberOfEvilYapLines.desc: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.

config.sba.numberOfMiningYapLines.desc: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.

config.sba.numberOfDangerYapLines.desc: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.
config.sba.numberOfEvilDangerYapLines.de: Change this if you want to add more yap lines to the lang file in a resource pack.
config.sba.detectedOreLightDuration.name: Ore Light Duration
config.sba.detectedOreLightDuration.desc: How long do the lights appear by ores? (200 ticks or 10 seconds by default)
config.sba.oreDetectionRadius.name: Ore Detection Radius
config.sba.oreDetectionRadius.desc: How many blocks away (default 20) can you detect ores?
config.sba.oreDetectionMaximum.name: Max Ores Detectable
config.sba.oreDetectionMaximum.desc: What's the maximum amount of ores (default 15) you can detect at once?
config.sba.oreDetectionCooldown.name: Ore Detection Cooldown
config.sba.oreDetectionCooldown.desc: What is the cooldown (default 300 ticks or 15 secodns) of detecting ores?
config.sba.yapCooldown.name: Encourage Cooldown
config.sba.yapCooldown.desc: What is the cooldown for cheering you on? (42 ticks or ~2 seconds by default)
config.sba.timeRewindOnlySavesAndLoadsOn: This setting is off by default, it makes time rewind only work on players. There might be a small marginal performance benefit from not saving past locations on entities in larger packs, so this ability is mostly for that.
config.sba.timeRewindCooldownv2.name: Rewind Cooldown
config.sba.timeRewindCooldownv2.desc: The time in between time rewinds. If you set it to 120 or less you can loop time infinitely like Ringo. But to prevent trolling and to make pve balanced, the default is 220 ticks (11 seconds).
config.sba.timeRewindCooldownExtraCondit: Additional ticks if you place and break blocks, or kill mobs before rewinding. This matters for balancing reasons because of how powerful this stand is in pve, and to limit pvp cheeses. Conceptually, since time rewind cannot rewind these things, you are altering time, default is 100 ticks (5 seconds).
config.sba.timeRewindCooldownUsesServerL: Let the server fully manage time rewind's cooldown. This is advisable because of the nature of the ability with bad TPS.
config.sba.chronoVisionRange.name: Chrono Vision Range
config.sba.chronoVisionRange.desc: The range at which Chrono Vision spawns particles to show the past locations of entities (50 by default).
config.sba.timeRewindRange.name: Rewind Range
config.sba.timeRewindRange.desc: The range of time rewind. It is not advisable to raise this too much for performance reasons. The default is 70 blocks.
config.sba.timeRewindStopsSuffocation.de: Prevent rewinding into a block, so you don't clip through anything or suffocate, or force anyone else you rewind to do the same. On by default. Rewinding time still rewinds their other aspects when this triggers, just not position related things.
config.sba.timeRewindStopsDeviousStrateg: Hinges on Anti-suffocate also being on, but additionally stops rewinding into cobwebs and lava. On by default.
config.sba.getMiningTierVampire.name: Mining Tier
config.sba.getMiningTierVampire.desc: Tier 0 is the default, it does not replace tools for harvesting blocks. Tier 1 is wood tier, tier 2 is stone tier, tier 3 is iron tier, and tier 4 is diamond tier.
config.sba.spikePullCooldownv2.name: Push/Pull Cooldown
config.sba.spikePullCooldownv2.desc: The cooldown of walking heart's movement ability with spikes.
config.sba.diveAttackCooldown.name: Dive Cooldown
config.sba.diveAttackCooldown.desc: The cooldown of vampire powers dive attack.
config.sba.spikeDiveAttackCooldown.name: Dive Cooldown
config.sba.spikeDiveAttackCooldown.desc: The cooldown of Walking Heart's dive attack.
config.sba.hairGrabCooldown.name: Hair Grab Cooldown
config.sba.hairGrabCooldown.desc: The cooldown of vampire hair grab.
config.sba.spikeAttackCooldown.name: Spike Attack Cooldown
config.sba.spikeAttackCooldown.desc: The cooldown of vampire hair spike attack.
config.sba.clutchCooldown.name: Clutch Cooldown
config.sba.clutchCooldown.desc: The cooldown of vampire clutch abilities.
config.sba.auraBlastCooldown.name: Aura Blast Cooldown
config.sba.auraBlastCooldown.desc: The cooldown of vampire dark aura blast.
config.sba.deflectionCooldown.name: Deflection Cooldown
config.sba.flowerHealCooldown.name: Flower Heal Cooldown
config.sba.bloodRegenCooldown.name: Blood Regen Cooldown
config.sba.bloodSpeedCooldown.name: Blood Speed Cooldown
config.sba.ripperEyesPartialCooldown.des: The cooldown of partially charged space ripper stingy eyes.
config.sba.ripperEyesMaxCooldown.name: Ripper Max Cooldown
config.sba.ripperEyesMaxCooldown.desc: The cooldown of fully charged space ripper stingy eyes.
config.sba.ripperEyesInterruptCooldown.d: The cooldown of interrupted space ripper stingy eyes.
config.sba.antiCheapShot.name: Anti Cheap Shot
config.sba.antiCheapShot.desc: Prevents using clutch moves right after daze moves. Otherwise, you can easily guarantee instakill progress.
config.sba.enableStoneMask.name: Enable Mask Vampires
config.sba.enableStoneMask.desc: If disabled, the stone mask can no longer make vampires.
config.sba.enableBloodVampirizing.name: Blood Vampires
config.sba.enableBloodVampirizing.desc: If disabled, vampire blood can no longer make players vampires.
config.sba.enableZombification.name: Zombification
config.sba.enableZombification.desc: If disabled, vampires and zombies can no longer make players zombies.
config.sba.SummonSurvivorCooldownV2.name: Summon Cooldown
config.sba.SummonSurvivorCooldownV2.desc: The cooldown between survivor stands being placed.
config.sba.SummonSurvivorCooldownCooldow: Let the server fully manage the cooldown of summoning survivors, so a lag spike doesn't lead to a hundred spawning at once.
config.sba.canonSurvivorHasNoRageCupid.d: DIO says Survivor is bad because it cannot discriminate between friend or foe, so in the spirit of that there is an option to disable rage cupid mode.
config.sba.rageCupidCooldown.name: Rage Cupid Cooldown
config.sba.rageCupidCooldown.desc: How long it takes for Rage Cupid to recharge.
config.sba.rageCupidCooldownCooldownUses: Let the server fully manage the cooldown of rage cupid, on by default because of how tps can affect mob AI.
config.sba.maxSurvivorsCount.name: Max Survivor Count
config.sba.maxSurvivorsCount.desc: The quantity of this stand that can be out at once. By default, you can summon 6 at once. Since they have a sizable range and need to be activated, it is usually not super valuable to have that many out at once.
config.sba.dryUpInNetherTicks.name: Nether Dry Up Ticks
config.sba.dryUpInNetherTicks.desc: How many ticks until Survivor dries up in The Nether? By default, it is 140 ticks, or 7 seconds.
config.sba.durationOfAggressiveAngerSett: This is how long those under Survivor's effect have the buffs and drawbacks. When they kill their targets, this status goes away. It is not connected to aggro (1200 ticks or one minute by default).
config.sba.speedMultiplierTowardsEnemy.d: By default, as mobs and players walk towards the target they are zapped to, they have increased speed. (1.2, or 20 percent more speed by default)
By default, as mobs and players walk away from the target they are zapped to, they suffer from reduced speed. (0.7, or 30 percent less speed by default)
config.sba.resilienceToNonMeleeAttacksWh: When zapped, mobs and players take reduced damage from all attacks, excluding melee. by (0.8, in other words 20 percent less by default)
When zapped, mobs and players deal this percentage more melee damage (1.20, in other words 20 percent more by default).
config.sba.bonusDamageWhenPunching.name: Increased Punching Damage
config.sba.bonusDamageWhenPunching.desc: Be like Westwood, when you are zapped you have increased increased punching strength while holding no items (3 damage default), but your punches also make you bleed. Note that this damage, although added to the base total in the same damage event, is calculated against armor separately, so it's not good for pvp.
config.sba.survivorRange.name: Base Range
config.sba.survivorRange.desc: The maximum distance from a survivor stand that a mob or player can be to get zapped on the stand's default mode (8 by default).
config.sba.survivorCupidRange.name: Cupid Survival Range
config.sba.survivorCupidRange.desc: The distance mobs can be from a highlighted survivor stand to get zapped in survival mode (8 by default).
config.sba.survivorCupidCreativeRange.de: The distance mobs can be from a highlighted survivor stand to get zapped in creative mode.
config.sba.canUseSurvivorOnBossesInSurvi: In survival, survivor does not work on bosses by default for balancing reasons.
config.sba.fallProtectionOnRelease.name: Release Fall Protection
config.sba.fallProtectionOnRelease.desc: When you exit a wall, grants fall immunity like a stand leap.
config.sba.enableWallWalking.name: Enable Wall Walking
config.sba.enableWallWalking.desc: Allows flipping directions to walk on walls. Generally, this feature is stable, but if you have a modpack that causes it to bug out/not work smoothly turn this off. Without wall walking, you gain an additional block of step height while your spikes are planted with walking heart.
config.sba.enableCornerCutting.name: Enable Corner Cutting
config.sba.enableCornerCutting.desc: Allows training wheel mode of Walking Heart by pressing V, so you can flip over corners.
config.sba.invisibilityPotionAsWell.name: Apply Invis Potion
config.sba.invisibilityPotionAsWell.desc: If you want the invisibility power to apply the potion effect as well, turn this on. This could be useful for map mods that respect players invisibility.
config.sba.hidesArmor.name: Hides Armor
config.sba.hidesArmor.desc: Makes the invisibility hide your armor. If turned off, impacts aggro range on top of literal visibility.
config.sba.hidesElytra.name: Hides Elytra
config.sba.hidesElytra.desc: Makes the invisibility hide your elytra. If turned off, impacts aggro range on top of literal visibility.
config.sba.hidesHeldItems.name: Hides Held Items
config.sba.hidesHeldItems.desc: Makes the invisibility hide the item you are holding.
config.sba.hidesPlacedBlocks.name: Hides Placed Blocks
config.sba.hidesPlacedBlocks.desc: Enables the ability to hide blocks if they are placed while invisible via skill key 3 (crouch input, unless you press the row switch button).
config.sba.hidesShotProjectiles.name: Hides Launched Items
config.sba.hidesShotProjectiles.desc: Makes the invisibility apply to items you throw, shoot, drop, etc.
config.sba.revealLocationWhenHurt.name: Damage Received Reveals Self
config.sba.revealLocationWhenHurt.desc: If damage is received from an entity removes your invisibility.
config.sba.revealLocationWhenDamaging.de: If damage is dealt to an entity removes your invisibility.
config.sba.revealLocationWhenFinishedEat: If finishing eating removes your invisibility.
config.sba.invisiBurstCooldown.name: Invisiburst Cooldown
config.sba.invisiBurstCooldown.desc: The amount of ticks in between turning invisible.
config.sba.invisiBurstCooldownMobs.name: Invisiburst Mob CD
config.sba.invisiBurstCooldownMobs.desc: The amount of ticks in between turning invisible for mobs.
config.sba.invisiBurstCooldownUsesServer: Let the server fully manage invisiburst's cooldown. This is advisable if you want a second of being visable between bursts for balancing reasons, because bad server tps could make it limitless..
config.sba.invisiBurstAlertsMobs.name: Invisiburst Alerts Mobs
config.sba.invisiBurstAlertsMobs.desc: Whether or not your aggro range becomes normal for a second after bursting, making mobs able to see you if you don't have cover.
config.sba.invisiBurstDuration.name: Invisiburst Duration
config.sba.invisiBurstDuration.desc: The amount of ticks of invisibility after you turn invisible. Applies to both mobs and blocks as well.
config.sba.invisiBurstRange.name: Invisiburst Range
config.sba.invisiBurstRange.desc: Change how far invisiburst extends outwards in turning mobs invisible.
config.sba.invisiBurstCrouchRange.name: Invisiburst Crouch Range
config.sba.invisiBurstCrouchRange.desc: Change how far the small variation of invisiburst extends outwards in turning mobs invisible.
config.sba.invisiBurstBlockRange.name: Invisiburst Block Range
config.sba.invisiBurstBlockRange.desc: The block radius of invisiburst, in full numbers. Set to zero to disable block invisibility.
config.sba.invisibleBlockDepthF.name: Invisible Block Depth
config.sba.invisibleBlockDepthF.desc: How see through should invisible blocks be? By default it is 0.44 out of 1 (1 is fully visible).
config.sba.invisibleBlocksDistanceAwaySe: How far away can you see the invisible blocks roughly as the stand user, raising this makes mining view more obstructed but might help with combat.
config.sba.greenDayAttackMultOnPlayers.d: How much damage the stand deals to players, and potentially stand user mobs. The base of 100 means x1.0, so at 0.5 the damage is halved and at 300 the damage is tripled for instance.
config.sba.greenDayAttackMultOnMobs.name: Mob Damage Multiplier
config.sba.greenDayAttackMultOnMobs.desc: How much damage the stand deals to every other mob, same math as above.
config.sba.greenDayGuardPoints.name: Guard Points
config.sba.greenDayGuardPoints.desc: How much raw, unreduced damage can the stand take before its guard breaks?
config.sba.miningSpeedMultiplierGreenDay: Adjust how fast the stand can mine.
config.sba.getMiningTierGreenDay.name: Mining Tier
config.sba.getMiningTierGreenDay.desc: Tier 0 is the default, it does not replace tools for harvesting blocks. Tier 1 is wood tier, tier 2 is stone tier, tier 3 is iron tier, and tier 4 is diamond tier.
config.sba.greenDayStitchHeal.name: Stitch Heal Amount
config.sba.greenDayStitchHeal.desc: The amount of health regained by Stitch
config.sba.gDStitchcooldown.name: Stitch Cooldown
config.sba.moldDefaultRange.name: Default Mold Spore Range
config.sba.moldDefaultRange.desc: Defines the radius, in blocks your mold spores start with when you first use the move
config.sba.moldFallSpeed.name: Mold Spores Fall Speed
config.sba.moldFallSpeed.desc: The speed at which mold spores fall, lower speeds will lead to them spreading over a wider area
config.sba.moldGrowthRate.name: Mold Spore Spread
config.sba.moldGrowthRate.desc: Controls the rate at which mold spores increase in range as they fall down
config.sba.moldSpreadCooldown.name: Mold Spread Cooldown
config.sba.armThrowCooldown.name: Arm Throw Cooldown
config.sba.armThrowCooldown.desc: The cooldown after using arm throw 2 times (Default is 120 ticks, or 6 secnds)
config.sba.armSpinDuration.name: Arm Spin Duration
config.sba.armSpinDuration.desc: How long your seperated arms spin for after using the move, default is 30 ticks, or 1.5 seconds
config.sba.armSpinCooldown.name: Arm Spin Cooldown
config.sba.moldDMGMobsMultiplier.name: Mold Damage Multiplier (Mobs)
config.sba.moldDMGMobsMultiplier.desc: Controls the damage mobs take when they fall in green days mold fields
config.sba.moldDMGPlayersMultiplier.name: Mold Damage Multiplier (Players)
config.sba.moldDMGPlayersMultiplier.desc: Controls the damage players take when they fall in green days mold fields
config.sba.moldMaxSize.name: Green Day Maximum Mold Range
config.sba.moldMaxSize.desc: Controls the maximum range of green day's mold fields
config.sba.playerMinFalldistance.name: Minimum Fall Distance
config.sba.playerMinFalldistance.desc: Controls how far players have to fall in the mold to begin taking damage
config.sba.eatingCancelsMold.name: Eating Cancels Mold
config.sba.eatingCancelsMold.desc: Controls Wether or not eating removes existing mold fields (balance)
config.sba.moldSpreadForceCooldown.name: Mold Spread Force Cooldown
config.sba.moldSpreadForceCooldown.desc: Cooldown when Mold Spread is put on cooldown by eating or using Mold Cancel, default is 360 ticks
config.sba.sneakyKilling.name: Silent Killer
config.sba.sneakyKilling.desc: When true, targets killed by a Killer Queen's explosions exclude the killer's name from their death messages. Also prevents mobs that lack a sightline with the user from becoming hostile when damaged by explosions.
config.sba.canUseBitesTheDustDayMode.des: Enables the 'Bites the Dust: Day Reset' skill. Useful to prevent disrupting users in multiplayer.
config.sba.bitesTheDustDayModeAffectGlob: 'Bites the Dust: Day Reset' rewinds global time
Allows 'Bites the Dust: Day Reset' to change the global time (disabled by default). When disabled, it will interpolate the sky on the client side before returning to normal, similar to Time Stop.
config.sba.bitesTheDustPlantCooldown.des: Sets the cooldown of the 'Bites the Dust' skill
config.sba.bitesTheDustCombatActivationC: Sets the cooldown of the 'Bites the Dust: Reveal' skill. This cooldown is also set when Bites the Dust is first planted.
config.sba.bitesTheDustCombatCooldownBon: Sets the added bonus cooldown to 'Bites the Dust: Reveal' when it is triggered manually
Set the amount of damage dealt to mobs by 'Bites the Dust: Reveal'
config.sba.bitesTheDustCombatPlayersDama: Set the amount of damage dealt to players by 'Bites the Dust: Reveal.' (if the config for stand user mobs to receive reduced damage is activated, they receive this damage instead)
config.sba.bombOverlayHideOnF1.name: F1 Hides Bomb Overlays
config.sba.bombOverlayHideOnF1.desc: Causes the overlay from 'Primary Bomb: Block' to derender when F1 is pressed.
config.sba.bombConfigFastToggle.name: 'Bomb Settings' fast toggle
config.sba.bombConfigFastToggle.desc: Exiting the menu of the 'Bomb Settings' skill with the mouse hovering over an option will click on the setting.
config.sba.itemToolsProtection.name: 'Primary Bomb: Item' Tool Protection
config.sba.itemToolsProtection.desc: When true, prevents tools and armor from being turned into bombs.
config.sba.blocksDestruction.name: Killer Queen Explosion Griefing
config.sba.blocksDestruction.desc: Toggles Killer Queen's explosions being able to break blocks.
config.sba.explosionDetonateMaxDamage.de: Sets the maximum amount of damage that a Killer Queen explosion can deal at point-blank range.
config.sba.sheerHeartAttackCooldown.name: 'Summon Sheer Heart Attack' Cooldown
config.sba.sheerHeartAttackCooldown.desc: Sets the cooldown of 'Summon Sheer Heart Attack'
config.sba.sheerHeartAttackThrowExtraCoo: Sets the extra cooldown for Sheer Heart Attack skills if 'Throw Sheer Heart Attack' was used.
config.sba.SheerHeartAttackMaxDamage.des: Sets the maximum amount of damages that a Sheer Heart Attack explosion can deal at point-blank range
config.sba.sheerHeartAttackSeenUndeadAnd: Toggles Sheer Heart Attack ignoring Undead and Arthropod mobs, as they doesn't emit heat. They still get targeted when on fire.
config.sba.killerQueenAttackMultOnPlayer: How much damage the stand deals to players, and potentially stand user mobs. The base of 100 means x1.0, so at 0.5 the damage is halved and at 300 the damage is tripled for instance.
config.sba.killerQueenAttackMultOnMobs.d: How much damage the stand deals to every other mob, same math as above.
config.sba.miningSpeedMultiplierKq.name: Mining Speed Multiplier
config.sba.miningSpeedMultiplierKq.desc: Adjust how fast the stand can mine.
config.sba.getMiningTierKq.name: Mining Tier
config.sba.getMiningTierKq.desc: Tier 0 is the default, it does not replace tools for harvesting blocks. Tier 1 is wood tier, tier 2 is stone tier, tier 3 is iron tier, and tier 4 is diamond tier.
config.sba.blockPlantCooldown.name: 'Primary Bomb: Block' Cooldown
config.sba.blockPlantCooldown.desc: Sets the cooldown of 'Primary Bomb: Block'
config.sba.mobPlantCooldown.name: 'Primary Bomb: Mob' cooldown
config.sba.mobPlantCooldown.desc: Sets the cooldown of 'Primary Bomb: Mob'
config.sba.explosionActivationCooldown.d: Sets the delay between a Killer Queen explosion being activated and taking place.
Sets the amount of damage dealt by 'Primary Bomb: Mob' explosions
config.sba.mobPlantWindup.name: 'Primary Bomb: Mob' Windup
config.sba.mobPlantWindup.desc: Sets the windup length of 'Primary Bomb: Mob' (3 seconds by default, 20 ticks = 1 second)
config.sba.sheerHeartAttackMaxExplosions: Sets the maximum number of times Sheer Heart Attack can explode before returning to the user
config.sba.mobPlantHitkillPlayers.name: 'Primary Bomb: Mob' One-shots Players
config.sba.mobPlantHitkillPlayers.desc: Causes 'Primary Bomb: Mob' to one-shot players (on by default)
config.sba.mobPlantHitkillMobs.name: 'Primary Bomb: Mob' One-shots mobs
config.sba.mobPlantHitkillMobs.desc: Causes 'Primary Bomb: Mob' to one-shot mobs (off by default)
config.sba.airBubbleGuardIncrease.name: 'Bubble Guard' Guard Bonus
config.sba.airBubbleGuardIncrease.desc: Amount of additional Guard Points granted by 'Bubble Guard'
config.sba.maxAirBubbleTravelDistanceBef: How far air bubbles can go before popping
config.sba.StrayCatAirBubblesDamage.name: Stray Cat Air Bubble Damage
config.sba.StrayCatAirBubblesDamage.desc: Sets the amount of damage dealt by non-exploded Air Bubbles on impact
config.sba.bubbleShootCooldown.name: 'Primary Bomb: Air Bubble' Cooldown
config.sba.bubbleShootCooldown.desc: Sets the cooldown of 'Primary Bomb: Air Bubble'
config.sba.itemPlantCooldown.name: 'Primary Bomb: Item' Cooldown
config.sba.itemPlantCooldown.desc: Sets the cooldown of 'Primary Bomb: Item'
config.sba.bitesTheDustCombatMinimunForF: Sets the earliest time in the Bites the Dust timeline that marked entities will take the maximum damage when detonated. Explosions before this time will deal between 20-100% of the full damage, depending on how much earlier the explosion takes place.
config.sba.bitesTheDustRewindRange.name: Bites the Dust Rewind Range
config.sba.bitesTheDustRewindRange.desc: Sets the range around Bites the Dust's host in which entities' data will be saved and rewound when using Bites the Dust skills
'Bites the Dust: Day Reset' Cooldown Bonus
Sets the cooldown bonus of 'Bites the Dust: Day Reset' after it is used.
config.sba.bitesTheDustDayGlobalRewind.n: 'Bites the Dust: Day Reset' Global Rewind
config.sba.bitesTheDustDayGlobalRewind.d: When true, 'Bites the Dust: Day Reset' rewinds all players on the server, disabled by default.
config.sba.bitesTheDustDayMobsDamage.des: Sets the amount of damage dealt to mobs by Bites the Dust explosions.
Sets the amount of damage dealt to players by Bites the Dust explosions.
config.sba.maximunBiteTheDustCombatActiv: Sets the number of times 'Bites the Dust: Reveal' can be used on a single host without resetting Bites the Dust. A value of 0 is limitless.
config.sba.killerQueenGuardPoints.name: Guard Points
config.sba.killerQueenGuardPoints.desc: How much raw, unreduced damage can the stand take before its guard breaks?
config.sba.theWorldAttackMultOnPlayers.d: How much damage the stand deals to players, and potentially stand user mobs. The base of 100 means x1.0, so at 0.5 the damage is halved and at 300 the damage is tripled for instance.
config.sba.theWorldAttackMultOnMobs.name: Mob Damage Multiplier
config.sba.theWorldAttackMultOnMobs.desc: How much damage the stand deals to every other mob, same math as above.
config.sba.theWorldGuardPoints.name: Guard Points
config.sba.theWorldGuardPoints.desc: How much raw, unreduced damage can the stand take before its guard breaks?
config.sba.miningSpeedMultiplierTheWorld: Adjust how fast the stand can mine.
config.sba.getMiningTierTheWorld.name: Mining Tier
config.sba.getMiningTierTheWorld.desc: Tier 0 is the default, it does not replace tools for harvesting blocks. Tier 1 is wood tier, tier 2 is stone tier, tier 3 is iron tier, and tier 4 is diamond tier.
config.sba.oxygenTankAdditionalTicks.des: How many ticks of oxygen do you want saved in The World's tank? The default, 300, is 15 seconds worth of extra underwater breathing.
config.sba.assaultCooldownv2.name: Assault Cooldown
config.sba.assaultCooldownv2.desc: After assault hits its target, set the resulting cooldown. (default is 40 ticks or 2 seconds)
config.sba.assaultInterruptCooldown.name: Assault Interrupt Cooldown
config.sba.assaultInterruptCooldown.desc: If you are hit before assault connects, this cooldown is incurred. (default is 60 ticks or 3 seconds)
Star Platinum's Time Stop lasts 100 ticks (5 seconds, Jotaro's highest achieved length) at a full charge by default.
config.sba.maxTimeStopTicksTheWorld.name: Max TW Length in Ticks
config.sba.maxTimeStopTicksTheWorld.desc: The World's Time Stop only gets extra seconds if it is fully charged and fully leveled, so this is the basic maximum you charge (100 ticks). Keep in mind pressing time stop again early lets use activate the ability without a full charge.
config.sba.maxTWChargeBonusTicks.name: Full Charge TW Ticks
config.sba.maxTWChargeBonusTicks.desc: When Time stop is fully charged and The World is fully leveled, it gains an additional 4 seconds (80 ticks). This lets it reach 9 seconds, which Araki later confirmed to be DIO's true limit (as opposed to the 11 seconds DIO presumed).
config.sba.maxSPChargeBonusTicks.name: Full Charge SP Ticks
config.sba.maxSPChargeBonusTicks.desc: The same as the above but for Star Platinum. By default, the mod offers a different advantage for Star Platinum's full charge (see below), so this is not recommended.
config.sba.reducedTSDamageDealt.name: Reduced Damage Dealt
config.sba.reducedTSDamageDealt.desc: By default, all attacks deal 66 Percent damage in stopped time for balancing reasoning. If you change it to 100, all attacks deal full damage. If you change it to zero, you cannot attack directly.
config.sba.maxSPBypassesReduction.name: Max SP Bypass Reduction
config.sba.maxSPBypassesReduction.desc: When time stop is fully charged, Star Platinum bypasses damage reduction to deal full damage. This is an ability designed to at least somewhat rival extra seconds, as the cooldown for time stop is dependent on seconds used by default.
config.sba.maxTWBypassesReduction.name: Max TW Bypass Reduction
config.sba.maxTWBypassesReduction.desc: The same as the above, but for The World. The World definitely does not need this with its 9 second Time Stop.
config.sba.impulseTimeStopLength.name: Impulse Length
config.sba.impulseTimeStopLength.desc: The length of using the crouch variation of Time Stop. It is an ability designed to emulate pressing the Time Stop key twice, just for people with really fast reaction time. But some users may want this ability to be more relevant or dominant in battle.
config.sba.rateOfChargingTimeStop.name: Charging Rate
config.sba.rateOfChargingTimeStop.desc: How many ticks of time stop do you charge per ticks that pass by? You start a time stop charge with 20 ticks, so at the default rate of 2 ticks, charging time stop fully takes two seconds. But if you raise Time Stop's length at all, you may want to consider increasing this rate, or the charging animation will take forever.
config.sba.timeStopMinimumCooldown.name: Minimum Cooldown
config.sba.timeStopMinimumCooldown.desc: When you end a time stop, regardless of what happens, this cooldown will always apply. Note there are other factors below that go into the cooldown length. Default is 200, 10 seconds.
config.sba.additionalCooldownPerSecondsU: The longer you spend in stopped time, without ending it early, the longer the cooldown is by these ticks. By default it is set to 100, so after every second of spent time you have to wait five additional seconds. This is to incentivize ending the ability early for a shorter cooldown and to balance the power of time stop.
Doing any action like attacking, eating, or launching projectiles in stopped time raises the cooldown even further by this amount (300 ticks or 15 seconds by default) once. This is to encourage using time stop for movement instead of attacking and for balancing reasons.
config.sba.timeStopInterruptedCooldownv2: The cooldown for getting hit and having your time stop canceled. By default, it is 80 ticks (4 seconds). This cooldown exists both for balancing, and to incentivize pressing the time stop button again early to prevent getting hit out of time stop, decreasing your TS time when you do so.
config.sba.timeStopInterruptedCooldownMo: The cooldown for getting hit and having your time stop canceled. By default, it is 80 ticks (4 seconds). This cooldown exists both for balancing, and to incentivize pressing the time stop button again early to prevent getting hit out of time stop, decreasing your TS time when you do so.
config.sba.timeStopIsAlwaysInterruptable: Whether or not you can even be interrupted while charging time stop. By default this is set to true for balancing reasons, but if you just want to be powerful set this to false.
config.sba.preventsBreathing.name: Prevents Breathing
config.sba.preventsBreathing.desc: Whether or not Time Stop uses your oxygen as well. Technically, Araki said in an interview that The World's Tanks were used for breathing in stopped time, so this option is an impractical homage to that, and is off by default.
config.sba.enableHovering.name: Enable Hovering
config.sba.enableHovering.desc: When holding spacebar, you can hover in stopped time by default. This is because Time Stop halts gravity. Time and gravity are connected in JoJo, and so DIO is shown hovering while time is stopped. Jotaro even hovers a bit in Part 4.
config.sba.enableCarryingWhileHovering.d: When you hover, drops targets that you grabbed. This is to prevent excessive fall damage tricks.
config.sba.mobsTeleportInsteadOfStopping: Mobs using The World teleport instead of truly stopping time. This is on by default because getting stopped by simple mob ai does not feel great from a gameplay perspective, nor is it fair for a creeper to do so. But if you want that to happen...
config.sba.wardenMovesInStoppedTime.name: Warden Can Move
config.sba.wardenMovesInStoppedTime.desc: The Warden can bypass stopped time, because it is a supernatural entity with special properties.
The maximum percentage of a player's health you can reduce in stopped time. By default, it is 30 percent of their max health.
Creative players can stop time on a dime forever, this is useful as a tool for building, stopping griefing or fire spread, taking screenshots, etc.
config.sba.blockRangeNegativeOneIsInfini: By default the ability has an 100 block radius so only players nearby feel it. If you set it to -1, it becomes global and actually stops the time of day beyond just visually.
config.sba.postTSiframes.name: Invincibility Ticks
config.sba.postTSiframes.desc: The amount of ticks after taking time damage in which you are immune to damage. Default is 19.
config.sba.postTSSoften.name: Post Stop Soften
config.sba.postTSSoften.desc: Whether or not players take reduced damage from things beyond your control (gasoline, stand attacks) after a time stop ends. The duration is proportionate to how long they are stopped, and only applies for stops that last more than a second.
config.sba.postTSCancel.name: Post Stop Cancel
config.sba.postTSCancel.desc: Whether or not certain moves get canceled when time resumes. Disable for legacy version.
config.sba.timestopLeapCooldown.name: Time Stop Leaping Cooldown
config.sba.timestopLeapCooldown.desc: Time stop is disabled for a short time after a leap
config.sba.starFingerLeapCooldown.name: Star Finger Leaping CD
config.sba.starFingerLeapCooldown.desc: Star Finger is disabled for a short time after a leap
config.sba.timestopCancelsFood.name: Time Stop Cancels Food
config.sba.timestopCancelsFood.desc: While in stopped time, you cannot gain healing from food
config.sba.postTESoften.name: Post TE Soften
config.sba.postTESoften.desc: If ending time erase makes certain damage after it ends weaker like time stop does. Good to prevent rushdown abuse.
config.sba.timestopCancelsGuns.name: Time Stop Cancels Guns
config.sba.timestopCancelsGuns.desc: Apparently Diego couldn't shoot guns in time stop, he was doing incredibly specific things like shooting the moment time resumes or punching bullets to set one up without shooting the gun normally.
config.sba.nerfedTEDamage.name: Nerfed TE PVP
config.sba.nerfedTEDamage.desc: Makes the fated self less physically strong with its punches by a small amount for balancing.
config.sba.nerfedPVPRunning.name: Nerfed PVP Running
config.sba.nerfedPVPRunning.desc: If in pvp, player skips are shorter distance.
config.sba.vampireAttackMultOnPlayers.de: How much damage vampires deals to players, and potentially stand user mobs. The base of 100 means x1.0, so at 0.5 the damage is halved and at 300 the damage is tripled for instance.
config.sba.vampireAttackMultOnMobs.name: Mob Damage Multiplier
config.sba.vampireAttackMultOnMobs.desc: How much damage vampires deals to every other mob, same math as above.
config.sba.d4cAttackMultOnPlayers.name: Player Damage Multiplier
config.sba.d4cAttackMultOnPlayers.desc: How much damage the stand deals to players, and potentially stand user mobs. The base of 100 means x1.0, so at 0.5 the damage is halved and at 300 the damage is tripled for instance.
config.sba.d4cAttackMultOnMobs.name: Mob Damage Multiplier
config.sba.d4cAttackMultOnMobs.desc: How much damage the stand deals to every other mob, same math as above.
config.sba.d4cGuardPoints.name: Guard Points
config.sba.d4cGuardPoints.desc: How much raw, unreduced damage can the stand take before its guard breaks?
config.sba.miningSpeedMultiplierD4c.name: Mining Speed Multiplier
config.sba.miningSpeedMultiplierD4c.desc: Adjust how fast the stand can mine.
config.sba.getMiningTierD4c.name: Mining Tier
config.sba.getMiningTierD4c.desc: Tier 0 is the default, it does not replace tools for harvesting blocks. Tier 1 is wood tier, tier 2 is stone tier, tier 3 is iron tier, and tier 4 is diamond tier.
config.sba.starPlatinumAttackMultOnPlaye: How much damage the stand deals to players, and potentially stand user mobs. The base of 100 means x1.0, so at 0.5 the damage is halved and at 300 the damage is tripled for instance.
How much damage the stand deals to every other mob, same math as above.

config.sba.starPlatinumGuardPoints.desc: How much raw, unreduced damage can the stand take before its guard breaks?
config.sba.miningSpeedMultiplierStarPlat: Adjust how fast the stand can mine.
config.sba.getMiningTierKingCrimson.name: Mining Tier
config.sba.getMiningTierKingCrimson.desc: Tier 0 is the default, it does not replace tools for harvesting blocks. Tier 1 is wood tier, tier 2 is stone tier, tier 3 is iron tier, and tier 4 is diamond tier.
config.sba.getMiningTierStarPlatinum.des: Tier 0 is the default, it does not replace tools for harvesting blocks. Tier 1 is wood tier, tier 2 is stone tier, tier 3 is iron tier, and tier 4 is diamond tier.
config.sba.starPlatinumScopeUsesPotionEf: If you have a mod like Bad Optimizations that deletes the vanilla code that scope uses to light things up, turn this on so it works regardless.
config.sba.guardianCooldown.name: Guardian Cooldown
config.sba.guardianCooldown.desc: Change the length in between scope grabbing and throwing incoming projectiles. (default is 160 or 8 seconds)
config.sba.starFingerCooldown.name: Star Finger Cooldown
config.sba.starFingerCooldown.desc: Change the length in between using Star Finger. (default is 80 or 4 seconds)
config.sba.starFingerInterruptCooldown.d: Change the length of interrupt time if you are hit our of star finger. (default is 80 or 4 seconds)
config.sba.blitzAttackCooldown.name: Star Blitz Cooldown
config.sba.blitzAttackCooldown.desc: Change the length in between ending impale early with the attack button and using Star Blitz.
config.sba.miningSpeedMultiplierKingCrim: Adjust how fast the stand can mine.
config.sba.miningSpeedMultiplierWhiteAlb: Adjust how fast the stand can mine.
config.sba.getMiningTierWhiteAlbum.name: Mining Tier
config.sba.getMiningTierWhiteAlbum.desc: Tier 0 is the default, it does not replace tools for harvesting blocks. Tier 1 is wood tier, tier 2 is stone tier, tier 3 is iron tier, and tier 4 is diamond tier.
config.sba.vampireUsesPotionEffectForNig: If you have a mod like Bad Optimizations that deletes the vanilla code that scope uses to light things up, turn this on so it works regardless.
config.sba.expPerVampLevelUp.name: Blood Experience Per Level
config.sba.expPerVampLevelUp.desc: Increase to make leveling take longer, decrease to make shorter.
config.sba.expTypeCapPerDay.name: Blood Experience Per Type
config.sba.expTypeCapPerDay.desc: Increase to let you get more blood exp from each mob type daily. it is kept low to prevent the need for massive animal farm hording.
config.sba.expInterval.name: Blood Experience Intervals
config.sba.expInterval.desc: Change how many ticks between vampire leveling exp.
config.sba.canSurviveInRain.name: Rain Blocks Sunlight
config.sba.canSurviveInRain.desc: If you want to cheat the challenge of vampirism while it's raining, enable this.
config.sba.sunDamageUnderwaterReach.name: Underwater Sun Damage Reach
config.sba.sunDamageUnderwaterReach.desc: Change how far underwater sunlight reaches. Zero makes sunlight not intrude on water.
config.sba.drownSpeedModifier.name: Vampire Oxygen Swim Slowdown
config.sba.drownSpeedModifier.desc: When drowning, instead of taking damage, vampiric players are slowed down using this multiplier. Lower = slower.
config.sba.sunDamagePercentPerDamageTick: How much of your health is drained, percentage wise of max health, per hit under the sun as a vampiric player? If you set this to 0, you will be fully immune to sunlight. Be warned that removing this drawback just makes vampires objectively better, and not vampires.
config.sba.vampireUsesInternalSaturation: Set to false to make forge appleskin render golden meat sticks over blood bar.
config.sba.levelsToGetStand.name: Arrow Stand Level Cost
config.sba.levelsToGetStand.desc: Obtaining a stand from a Stand Arrow costs 15 levels by default.
By default, it costs 1 level to change the stand charged on a stand arrow. Keep in mind using the arrow on a mob also rerolls it (and uses 1 durability).
config.sba.canAwakenOtherPlayersWithArro: By default, shooting another player with a stand arrow does not awaken their stand to prevent forcing someone to be stuck with something bad.
config.sba.standArrowsHideResults.name: Arrows Hide Results
config.sba.standArrowsHideResults.desc: Enable to make the stand on an arrow a mystery. You may become "stuck" with a stand you don't like or waste extra levels on duplicates.
config.sba.classicGasoline.name: Classic Gasoline
config.sba.classicGasoline.desc: Turn on for gasoline to be super oppressive in pvp like it used to be.
config.sba.canThrowVisagesOntoOtherPlaye: Whether or not stand item throws with visages can apply the visages on players. Mostly exists for debug testing.
config.sba.standDiscsDropWithKeepGameRul: If the gamerule for losing stands on death is on, you instead drop your stand disc on death if this setting is enabled.
config.sba.locacacaEatingCooldowns.name: New Locacaca Cooldown
config.sba.locacacaEatingCooldowns.desc: The time between eating New Locacaca fruits, in ticks. By default, it takes roughly a minute in between, due to the powerful healing potential.
config.sba.knifeDamageOnMobs.name: Knife Mob Damage
config.sba.knifeDamageOnMobs.desc: A damage multiplier for knives hitting mobs. Knives do not bypass armor, but they do penetrate enchantments for the most part.
config.sba.gunDamageOnMobs.name: Gun Damage
config.sba.gunDamageOnMobs.desc: A damage multiplier for guns hitting mobs. Guns have higher dps than bows, but are still scaled to vanilla by default.
config.sba.knifeDamageOnPlayers.name: Knife Player Damage
config.sba.knifeDamageOnPlayers.desc: A damage multiplier for knives hitting players. Knives do not bypass armor, but they do penetrate enchantments for the most part.
config.sba.gunDamageOnPlayers.name: Gun Player Damage
config.sba.gunDamageOnPlayers.desc: A damage multiplier for guns hitting players. Guns are super fast, accurate, and have no windup. So it is not recommended to make them more powerful against players, they are mostly for inflicting bleed.
config.sba.rifleDamage.name: Rifle Damage
config.sba.rifleDamage.desc: Before being multiplied by the above, how much damage does the rifle cap at?
config.sba.snubnoseDamage.name: Snubnose Damage
config.sba.snubnoseDamage.desc: Before being multiplied by the above, the base snubnose damage. (it does +1 bonus damage if you hit while not on i-frames as well)
config.sba.coltDamage.name: Colt Damage
config.sba.coltDamage.desc: Before being multiplied by the above, the base colt damage.
config.sba.berettaDamage.name: Beretta Damage
config.sba.berettaDamage.desc: Before being multiplied by the above, the base beretta damage.
config.sba.tommyGunDamage.name: Tommy Gun Damage
config.sba.tommyGunDamage.desc: Before being multiplied by the above, the base tommy gun damage.
config.sba.maxKnivesInOneHit.name: Max Knives In One Hit
config.sba.maxKnivesInOneHit.desc: The maximum amount of knives that can hit an entity at once. For instance, if you stop time and surround an entity with knife bundles, where is the limit?
config.sba.gasolineExplosionDamage.name: Gasoline Damage Multiplier
config.sba.gasolineExplosionDamage.desc: A damage multiplier for gasoline explosions.
config.sba.matchDamage.name: Match Damage Multiplier
config.sba.matchDamage.desc: A damage multiplier for thrown matches.
config.sba.totemRange.name: Totem Of Doom Range
config.sba.totemRange.desc: How far the Totem of Doom goes, in radius. 40 is the default.
config.sba.totemDuration.name: Totem Of Doom Duration
config.sba.totemDuration.desc: How long the Totem of Doom lasts, in seconds. 5 minutes (300 seconds) is the default.
config.sba.doomImmunityDuration.name: Doom Mob Immunity Duration
config.sba.doomImmunityDuration.desc: How long mobs are immune to doomed upon being hurt, in seconds. 30 seconds is the default.
config.sba.switchStandDiscLength.name: Stand Disc Switch Length
config.sba.switchStandDiscLength.desc: The length of switching stands is 100 ticks, or 5 seconds by default.
config.sba.switchStandDiscWhileOnCooldow: The length of switching stands while already on an ability cooldown is increased to 300 ticks (15 seconds) by default.
config.sba.chanceForMergeLoot.name: Merge Loot Chance
config.sba.chanceForMergeLoot.desc: Set the percentage chance that using world merge creates a merge loot chest (loot in advanced config). 100 Percent would be 1.0.
config.sba.worthyMobOdds.name: Worthy Mob Chance
config.sba.worthyMobOdds.desc: Set the percentage of mobs that are worthy to have stands if shot with arrows. By default, it is 0.05, or 5 Percent of all mobs (1 in 20). 100 Percent would be 1.0.
config.sba.standUserOdds.name: Stand User Mob Chance
config.sba.standUserOdds.desc: Set the percentage of mobs that are natural stand users. By default, it is 0.005 or 0.5 Percent of all mobs (1 in 200). 100 Percent would be 1.0.
config.sba.standUserVillagerOdds.name: Stand User Villager Chance
config.sba.standUserVillagerOdds.desc: The chance of a Villager being a natural stand user. By default, it is 0.02, or 2 Percent of all Villagers (1 in 50).
config.sba.userAndWorthyBreedingOddsBonu: Bonus Percent chances of a worthy or stand user mob passing it down. By default, there is a 15 percent worthiness bonus passed per worthy parent, and a 15 percent natural stand user bonus passed on per stand user parent.
config.sba.multiplyAboveForVillagerBreed: Multiply the above number by 2x by default if the parents are villagers. This is truly the part 8 family experience.
config.sba.standUserMonstersDropMeteorit: Monsters who are natural stand users drop meteorite by default when killed by the player.
config.sba.bossMobsCanNaturallyHaveStand: Whether or not boss mobs also have a chance of being stand users. By default, it's a no, so you don't get cheated by an unfair fight.
config.sba.standUserMobsTakePlayerDamage: By default, stand user mobs take the player damage multipliers in the config instead of mob damage multipliers for balancing reasons. Changing this makes them take the full damage instead.
config.sba.percentOfZombieVillagersThatB: The percentage of zombie villagers that become zombie aestheticians instead.
config.sba.disableBleedingAndBloodSplatt: If you are sensitive to blood, this setting might help.
config.sba.CBHasDurability.name: Durability
config.sba.CBHasDurability.desc: Makes the stand have a block-like property, that means you can break their block and hit the user.
config.sba.CBDurability.name: Durability amount
config.sba.CBDurability.desc: Defines the amount of durability point 20cb has (durability needs to be turned on).
config.sba.CBchangesFOV.name: Change FOV
config.sba.CBchangesFOV.desc: Set if you FOV is changed when activating the 20th Century Boy ability.
config.sba.CBCanMoveCamera.name: Can move camera when in stance
config.sba.CBCanMoveCamera.desc: Set if you are able to freely move the camera when activating 20th Century Boy ability.
config.sba.enableCenturyBoy.name: Enable Stand
config.sba.enableCenturyBoy.desc: Turn the stand on or off. If off, the stand disc will not work or be in arrow/mob pools no matter what.
config.sba.oldKnockbackStance.name: Old knockback stance
config.sba.oldKnockbackStance.desc: Makes so that the damage received while in the knockback stance directly multiply the amount of knockback you take.
config.sba.buffedGroundStance.name: Buffed ground stance
config.sba.buffedGroundStance.desc: The current version of the ground stance makes some exceptions to what kinds of damage can be redirected, this config disables that.
config.sba.antiStallSetting.name: Anti Stall
config.sba.antiStallSetting.desc: Set if the anti stalling mechanic is enabled.
config.sba.useOldStallSytem.name: Use old stalling system
config.sba.useOldStallSytem.desc: Sets if when the Anti Stall setting is enabled, it will use the old system which instead of kicking the player of stance, it will make them die of 'stopped thinking'
config.sba.invincibilityCooldown.name: Invincibility Cooldown
config.sba.invincibilityCooldown.desc: Sets the cooldown of the Invincibility skill
config.sba.enableWhitesnake.name: Enable Stand
config.sba.enableWhitesnake.desc: Turn the stand on or off. If off, the stand disc will not work or be in arrow/mob pools no matter what.
config.sba.timeSparkCooldown.name: Time Spark Cooldown
config.sba.hallucinationAppliesMelting.d: Applies an equal level of Melting alongside Hallucination.
config.sba.hideHallucinationParticles.de: Hides potion particles produced by Hallucination.
config.sba.hallucinationHidesEffects.des: Hides the affected player's effect list while hallucinating.
Ticks of acid exposure needed to increase Hallucination by one level.
config.sba.acidTossAlwaysExpires.name: Acid Toss Always Expires
config.sba.acidTossAlwaysExpires.desc: Acid created by Acid Toss outside Melting Mode expires even while its user is nearby.

config.sba.hallucinatoryAcidDripsCreateB: Allows acid drips to form or build up acid blocks.
config.sba.waterWashesAwayAcid.name: Water Washes Away Acid
config.sba.waterWashesAwayAcid.desc: Allows flowing water to remove Hallucinatory Acid.
config.sba.acidGriefing.name: Acid Griefing
config.sba.acidGriefing.desc: Allows Hallucinatory Acid to dissolve supported blocks.
config.sba.acidDissolveSpeed.name: Acid Dissolve Speed
config.sba.acidDissolveSpeed.desc: Multiplier for the rate at which acid dissolves blocks.

config.sba.controlModeRange.desc: Maximum horizontal distance between Whitesnake and its user.
config.sba.controlModeVerticalRange.name: Control Mode Vertical Range
config.sba.controlModeVerticalRange.desc: Maximum vertical distance between Whitesnake and its user.
config.sba.meltingModeHoverDuration.name: Melting Mode Hover Duration
config.sba.meltingModeHoverDuration.desc: Maximum Melting Mode hover duration in ticks.
config.sba.forceThirdPersonInControlMode: Force Third Person in Control Mode
Automatically switches to third person while controlling Whitesnake.
config.sba.hallucinationIndicator.name: Hallucination Indicator
config.sba.hallucinationIndicator.desc: Displays an indicator above the heads of hallucinating targets, seen only if you have whitesnake yourself.

config.sba.discStealDealsDamage.desc: Whether Disc Steal also damages its target.

config.sba.standDiscStealEnabled.desc: Allows Stand Discs to be selected in the Disc Steal menu.
config.sba.memoryDiscStealEnabled.name: Enable Memory Disc Steal
config.sba.memoryDiscStealEnabled.desc: Allows Memory Discs to be selected in the Disc Steal menu.
config.sba.sightDiscStealEnabled.name: Enable Sight Discs
config.sba.sightDiscStealEnabled.desc: Enables Sight Discs and allows them to be selected in the Disc Steal menu.
config.sba.hearingDiscStealEnabled.name: Enable Hearing Discs
config.sba.hearingDiscStealEnabled.desc: Enables Hearing Discs and allows them to be selected in the Disc Steal menu.
Minimum Hallucination level required to steal a disc. Set to 0 to disable.
config.sba.stealDiscWhenLowHealth.name: Steal Disc when low health
config.sba.stealDiscWhenLowHealth.desc: When the target is below 2 health (1 heart), the disc is stolen rather than sealed.
config.sba.stealPlayerDiscs.name: Steal Player Discs
config.sba.stealPlayerDiscs.desc: When false, player discs can only be sealed and cannot be stolen as an item. Do true for the canon yet unfair experience.
config.sba.ejectType.name: Disc Ejection Type
config.sba.ejectType.desc: 1 = Drop the disc toward a random direction. 2 = Put the disc directly into the user's inventory, unless inventory is full.
config.sba.discSealing.name: Enable Disc Sealing
config.sba.discSealing.desc: Allows failed disc thefts to temporarily seal discs.

config.sba.standDiscSealTime.desc: Base Stand Disc seal duration in ticks.

config.sba.hearingDiscSealTime.desc: Base Hearing Disc seal duration in ticks.
config.sba.discSealHallucinationMultipli: Seal-duration percentage added per Hallucination level.

config.sba.explosiveDiscDamage.desc: Damage dealt by an Explosive Command Disc.
config.sba.generalDetectionGoThroughDoor: Some of the mod's area of affect or line of sight mechanics stop when they hit a block, turning  this off lets you hit past corners and doors with certain things. Not recommended.
